213.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮ ਨੇਮ ॥
213.t: kaahoo jaap kaahoo taap kaahoo poojaa hom nem ||
213.e: Some chant in meditation, some practice deep, austere meditation; some worship Him in adoration, some practice daily rituals.

213.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ ਗਉਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
213.t: kaahoo ho gaun kar ho ||2||
213.e: Some live the life of a wanderer. ||2||

213.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਤੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
213.t: kaahoo teer kaahoo neer kaahoo bedh beechaar ||
213.e: Some live by the shore, some live on the water; some study the Vedas.

213.g: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹੋ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫੫॥
213.t: naanakaa bhagat pria ho ||3||2||155||
213.e: Nanak loves to worship the Lord. ||3||2||155||

213.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
213.t: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
213.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

213.g: ਗੁਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
213.t: gun keerat nidh moree ||1|| rahaau ||
213.e: To sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is my treasure. ||1||Pause||

213.g: ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਜਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਤੂਹੀ ਰੰਗ ॥
213.t: too(n)hee ras too(n)hee jas too(n)hee roop toohee ra(n)g ||
213.e: You are my delight, You are my praise. You are my beauty, You are my love.

213.g: ਆਸ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
213.t: aas oT prabh toree ||1||
213.e: O God, You are my hope and support. ||1||

213.g: ਤੂਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਧਾਨ ਤੂਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
213.t: toohee maan too(n)hee dhaan toohee pat toohee praan ||
213.e: You are my pride, You are my wealth. You are my honor, You are my breath of life.

213.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਲੈ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
213.t: gur tooTee lai joree ||2||
213.e: The Guru has repaired that which was broken. ||2||

213.g: ਤੂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਗਾਉ ਤੂਹੀ ਸੁਨਿ ॥
213.t: toohee gireh toohee ban toohee gaau toohee sun ||
213.e: You are in the household, and You are in the forest. You are in the village, and You are in the wilderness.

214.t: hai naanak ner neree ||3||3||156||
214.e: Nanak: You are near, so very near! ||3||3||156||

214.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
214.t: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
214.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

214.g: ਮਾਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
214.t: maato har ra(n)g maato ||1|| rahaau ||
214.e: I am intoxicated, intoxicated with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

214.g: ਓੁਹੀ ਪੀਓ ਓੁਹੀ ਖੀਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦੀਓ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ॥
214.t: ouhee peeo ouhee kheeo gureh dheeo dhaan keeo ||
214.e: I drink it in - I am drunk with it. The Guru has given it to me in charity.

214.g: ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ॥੧॥
214.t: auaahoo siau man raato ||1||
214.e: My mind is drenched with it. ||1||

214.g: ਓੁਹੀ ਭਾਠੀ ਓੁਹੀ ਪੋਚਾ ਉਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਉਹੀ ਰੂਚਾ ॥
214.t: ouhee bhaaThee ouhee pochaa uhee piaaro uhee roochaa ||
214.e: It is my furnace, it is the cooling plaster. It is my love, it is my longing.

214.g: ਮਨਿ ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤੋ ॥੨॥
214.t: man oho sukh jaato ||2||
214.e: My mind knows it as peace. ||2||

214.g: ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਅਨਦ ਖੇਲ ਰਹੇ ਫੇਰ ਭਏ ਮੇਲ ॥
214.t: sahaj kel anadh khel rahe fer bhe mel ||
214.e: I enjoy intuitive peace, and I play in bliss; the cycle of reincarnation is ended for me, and I am merged with the Lord.

214.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਾਤੋ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੫੭॥
214.t: naanak gur sabadh paraato ||3||4||157||
214.e: Nanak is pierced through with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||4||157||

214.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੌੜੀ ਮਾਲਵਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
214.t: raag gauaRee maalavaa mahalaa panjavaa
214.e: Raag Gauree Maalwaa, Fifth Mehla:

214.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
214.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
214.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

214.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭੈਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
214.t: har naam leh meetaa leh aagai bikham pa(n)th bhaiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
214.e: Chant the Lord's Name; O my friend, chant it. Hereafter, the path is terrifying and treacherous. ||1||Pause||

214.g: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
214.t: sevat sevat sadhaa sev terai sa(n)g basat hai kaal ||
214.e: Serve, serve, forever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.

214.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਹੋ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
214.t: kar sevaa too(n) saadh kee ho kaaTeeaai jam jaal ||1||
214.e: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||

214.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
214.t: hom jag teerath ke'ee bich haumai badhe bikaar ||
214.e: You may make burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts and pilgrimages to sacred shrines in egotism, but your corruption only increases.

214.g: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
214.t: narak surag dhui bhu(n)chanaa hoi bahur bahur avataar ||2||
214.e: You are subject to both heaven and hell, and you are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

214.g: ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
214.t: siv puree braham i(n)dhr puree nihachal ko thaau naeh ||
214.e: The realm of Shiva, the realms of Brahma and Indra as well - no place anywhere is permanent.

214.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
214.t: bin har sevaa sukh nahee ho saakat aaveh jaeh ||3||
214.e: Without serving the Lord, there is no peace at all. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation. ||3||

214.g: ਜੈਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹਿਆ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
214.t: jaiso gur upadhesiaa mai taiso kahiaa pukaar ||
214.e: As the Guru has taught me, so have I spoken.

214.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੮॥
214.t: naanak kahai sun re manaa kar keeratan hoi udhaar ||4||1||158||
214.e: Says Nanak, listen, people: sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and you shall be saved. ||4||1||158||

214.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
214.t: raag gauRee maalaa mahalaa panjavaa
214.e: Raag Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehla:

214.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
214.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
214.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

214.g: ਪਾਇਓ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੇ ॥
214.t: paio baal budh sukh re ||
214.e: Adopting the innocent mind of a child, I have found peace.

214.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਹਾਨਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਦੂਖ ਸੁਖ ਚਿਤਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
214.t: harakh sog haan mrit dhookh sukh chit samasar gur mile ||1|| rahaau ||
214.e: Joy and sorrow, profit and loss, birth and death, pain and pleasure - they are all the same to my consciousness, since I met the Guru. ||1||Pause||

214.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਚਉ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਦੁਖਨੁ ਭਰੇ ॥
214.t: jau lau hau kichh sochau chitavau tau lau dhukhan bhare ||
214.e: As long as I plotted and planned things, I was full of frustration.

214.g: ਜਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਉ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜੇ ॥੧॥
214.t: jau kirapaal gur pooraa bheTiaa tau aanadh sahaje ||1||
214.e: When I met the Kind, Perfect Guru, then I obtained bliss so easily. ||1||

214.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
214.t: jetee siaanap karam hau ke'ee tete ba(n)dh pare ||
214.e: The more clever tricks I tried, the more bonds I was saddled with.

214.g: ਜਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥੨॥
214.t: jau saadhoo kar masatak dhario tab ham mukat bhe ||2||
214.e: When the Holy Saint placed His Hand upon my forehead, then I was liberated. ||2||

214.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਰਤੋ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
214.t: jau lau mero mero karato tau lau bikh ghere ||
214.e: As long as I claimed, ""Mine, mine!"", I was surrounded by wickedness and corruption.

214.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਏ ॥੩॥
214.t: man tan budh arapee Thaakur kau tab ham sahaj soe ||3||
214.e: But when I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to my Lord and Master, then I began to sleep in peace. ||3||

214.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਈ ਚਲਿਅਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਡਾਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
214.t: jau lau poT uThaiee chaliaau tau lau ddaan bhare ||
214.e: As long as I walked along, carrying the load, I continued to pay the fine.

214.g: ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੯॥
214.t: poT ddaar gur pooraa miliaa tau naanak nirabhe ||4||1||159||
214.e: But I threw away that bundle, when I met the Perfect Guru; O Nanak, then I became fearless. ||4||1||159||

214.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
214.t: gauRee maalaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
214.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehla:

214.g: ਭਾਵਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਰੀ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
214.t: bhaavan tiaagio ree tiaagio ||
214.e: I have renounced my desires; I have renounced them.

214.g: ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
214.t: tiaagio mai gur mil tiaagio ||
214.e: I have renounced them; meeting the Guru, I have renounced them.

214.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੈ ਆਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
214.t: sarab sukh aana(n)dh ma(n)gal ras maan gobi(n)dhai aagio ||1|| rahaau ||
214.e: All peace, joy, happiness and pleasures have come since I surrendered to the Will of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

215.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.t: maan abhimaan dhouoo samaane masatak ddaar gur paagio ||
215.e: Honor and dishonor are the same to me; I have placed my forehead upon the Guru's Feet.

215.g: ਸੰਪਤ ਹਰਖੁ ਨ ਆਪਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
215.t: sa(n)pat harakh na aapat dhookhaa ra(n)g Thaakurai laagio ||1||
215.e: Wealth does not excite me, and misfortune does not disturb me; I have embraced love for my Lord and Master. ||1||

215.g: ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.t: baas baasaree ekai suaamee udhiaan dhirasaTaagio ||
215.e: The One Lord and Master dwells in the home; He is seen in the wilderness as well.

215.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥
215.t: nirabhau bhe sa(n)t bhram ddaario pooran sarabaagio ||2||
215.e: I have become fearless; the Saint has removed my doubts. The All-knowing Lord is pervading everywhere. ||2||

215.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.t: jo kichh karatai kaaran keeno man buro na laagio ||
215.e: Whatever the Creator does, my mind is not troubled.

215.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
215.t: saadhasa(n)gat parasaadh sa(n)tan kai soio man jaagio ||3||
215.e: By the Grace of the Saints and the Company of the Holy, my sleeping mind has been awakened. ||3||

215.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਪਰਿਓ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.t: jan naanak oR tuhaaree pario aaio saranaagio ||
215.e: Servant Nanak seeks Your Support; he has come to Your Sanctuary.

215.g: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੦॥
215.t: naam ra(n)g sahaj ras maane fir dhookh na laagio ||4||2||160||
215.e: In the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he enjoys intuitive peace; pain no longer touches him. ||4||2||160||

215.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
215.t: gauRee maalaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
215.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehla:

215.g: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
215.t: paiaa laal ratan man paiaa ||
215.e: I have found the jewel of my Beloved within my mind.

215.g: ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
215.t: tan seetal man seetal theeaa satagur sabadh samaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
215.e: My body is cooled, my mind is cooled and soothed, and I am absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

215.g: ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
215.t: laathee bhookh tirasan sabh laathee chi(n)taa sagal bisaaree ||
215.e: My hunger has departed, my thirst has totally departed, and all my anxiety is forgotten.

215.g: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਧਰਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
215.t: kar masatak gur poorai dhario man jeeto jag saaree ||1||
215.e: The Perfect Guru has placed His Hand upon my forehead; conquering my mind, I have conquered the whole world. ||1||

215.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਅਬ ਚੂਕੇ ॥
215.t: tirapat aghai rahe ridh a(n)tar ddolan te ab chooke ||
215.e: Satisfied and satiated, I remain steady within my heart, and now, I do not waver at all.

215.g: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਮੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
215.t: akhuT khajaanaa satigur dheeaa toT nahee re mooke ||2||
215.e: The True Guru has given me the inexhaustible treasure; it never decreases, and never runs out. ||2||

215.g: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
215.t: acharaj ek sunahu re bhaiee gur aaisee boojh bujhaiee ||
215.e: Listen to this wonder, O Siblings of Destiny: the Guru has given me this understanding.

215.g: ਲਾਹਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
215.t: laeh paradhaa Thaakur jau bheTio tau bisaree taat paraiee ||3||
215.e: I threw off the veil of illusion, when I met my Lord and Master; then, I forgot my jealousy of others. ||3||

215.g: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
215.t: kahio na jaiee eh acha(n)bhau so jaanai jin chaakhiaa ||
215.e: This is a wonder which cannot be described. They alone know it, who have tasted it.

215.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੧॥
215.t: kahu naanak sach bhe bigaasaa gur nidhaan ridhai lai raakhiaa ||4||3||161||
215.e: Says Nanak, the Truth has been revealed to me. The Guru has given me the treasure; I have taken it and enshrined it within my heart. ||4||3||161||

215.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
215.t: gauRee maalaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
215.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehla:

215.g: ਉਬਰਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
215.t: aubarat raajaa raam kee saranee ||
215.e: Those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the King, are saved.

215.g: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਤੇ ਧਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
215.t: sarab lok maiaa ke ma(n)ddal gir gir parate dharanee ||1|| rahaau ||
215.e: All other people, in the mansion of Maya, fall flat on their faces on the ground. ||1||Pause||

215.g: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਇਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
215.t: saasat si(n)mirat bedh beechaare mahaa purakhan iau kahiaa ||
215.e: The great men have studied the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas, and they have said this:

215.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
215.t: bin har bhajan naahee nisataaraa sookh na kinahoo(n) lahiaa ||1||
215.e: "Without the Lord's meditation, there is no emancipation, and no one has ever found peace."||1||

215.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਕੀ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਬੂਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਹਰੇ ॥
215.t: teen bhavan kee lakhamee joree boojhat naahee lahare ||
215.e: People may accumulate the wealth of the three worlds, but the waves of greed are still not subdued.

215.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤੋ ਪਹਰੇ ਪਹਰੇ ॥੨॥
215.t: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paavai firato pahare pahare ||2||
215.e: Without devotional worship of the Lord, where can anyone find stability? People wander around endlessly. ||2||

215.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਰਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
215.t: anik bilaas karat man mohan pooran hot na kaamaa ||
215.e: People engage in all sorts of mind-enticing pastimes, but their passions are not fulfilled.

215.g: ਜਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬੂਝਤ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
215.t: jalato jalato kabahoo na boojhat sagal birathe bin naamaa ||3||
215.e: They burn and burn, and are never satisfied; without the Lord's Name, it is all useless. ||3||

215.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
215.t: har kaa naam japahu mere meetaa ihai saar sukh pooraa ||
215.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, my friend; this is the essence of perfect peace.

215.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬੨॥
215.t: saadhasa(n)gat janam maran nivaarai naanak jan kee dhooraa ||4||4||162||
215.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, birth and death are ended. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||4||162||

215.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
215.t: gauRee maalaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
215.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehla:

215.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
215.t: mo kau ieh bidh ko samajhaavai ||
215.e: Who can help me understand my condition?

215.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
215.t: karataa hoi janaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
215.e: Only the Creator knows it. ||1||Pause||

215.g: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
215.t: anajaanat kichh ineh kamaano jap tap kachhoo na saadhaa ||
215.e: This person does things in ignorance; he does not chant in meditation, and does not perform any deep, self-disciplined meditation.

215.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਉਰਾਇਓ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
215.t: dheh dhis lai ih man dhauraio kavan karam kar baadhaa ||1||
215.e: This mind wanders around in the ten directions - how can it be restrained? ||1||

215.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
215.t: man tan dhan bhoom kaa Thaakur hau is kaa ih meraa ||
215.e: "I am the lord, the master of my mind, body, wealth and lands. These are mine."

216.g: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹ ਪੈਖਰ ਪਏ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੨॥
216.t: bharam moh kachh soojhas naahee ieh paikhar pe pairaa ||2||
216.e: In doubt and emotional attachment, this person understands nothing; with this leash, these feet are tied up. ||2||

216.g: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
216.t: tab ih kahaa kamaavan pariaa jab ih kachhoo na hotaa ||
216.e: What did this person do, when he did not exist?

216.g: ਜਬ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੩॥
216.t: jab ek nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar prabh sabh kichh aapeh karataa ||3||
216.e: When the Immaculate and Formless Lord God was all alone, He did everything by Himself. ||3||

216.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
216.t: apane karatab aape jaanai jin ih rachan rachaiaa ||
216.e: He alone knows His actions; He created this creation.

216.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬੩॥
216.t: kahu naanak karanahaar hai aape satigur bharam chukaiaa ||4||5||163||
216.e: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Doer. The True Guru has dispelled my doubts. ||4||5||163||

216.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
216.t: gauRee maalaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
216.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehla:

216.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਬਿਰਥੇ ॥
216.t: har bin avar kiraa birathe ||
216.e: Without the Lord, other actions are useless.

216.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਇਹਿ ਓਰੈ ਮੂਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
216.t: jap tap sa(n)jam karam kamaane ieh orai moose ||1|| rahaau ||
216.e: Meditative chants, intense deep meditation, austere self-discipline and rituals - these are plundered in this world. ||1||Pause||

216.g: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਢੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
216.t: barat nem sa(n)jam meh rahataa tin kaa aadd na paiaa ||
216.e: Fasting, daily rituals, and austere self-discipline - those who keep the practice of these, are rewarded with less than a shell.

216.g: ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
216.t: aagai chalan aaur hai bhaiee uoo(n)haa kaam na aaiaa ||1||
216.e: Hereafter, the way is different, O Siblings of Destiny. There, these things are of no use at all. ||1||

216.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
216.t: teerath nai ar dharanee bhramataa aagai Thaur na paavai ||
216.e: Those who bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wander over the earth, find no place of rest hereafter.

216.g: ਊਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਓਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
216.t: uoohaa kaam na aavai ieh bidh oh logan hee pateeaavai ||2||
216.e: There, these are of no use at all. By these things, they only please other people. ||2||

216.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਆਗੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
216.t: chatur bedh mukh bachanee ucharai aagai mahal na paieeaai ||
216.e: Reciting the four Vedas from memory, they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence hereafter.

216.g: ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
216.t: boojhai naahee ek sudhaakhar oh sagalee jhaakh jhakhaieeaai ||3||
216.e: Those who do not understand the One Pure Word, utter total nonsense. ||3||

216.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੋ ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਜਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮੀ ॥
216.t: naanak kahato ih beechaaraa j kamaavai su paar garaamee ||
216.e: Nanak voices this opinion: those who practice it, swim across.

216.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬੪॥
216.t: gur sevahu ar naam dhiaavahu tiaagahu manahu gumaanee ||4||6||164||
216.e: Serve the Guru, and meditate on the Naam; renounce the egotistical pride from your mind. ||4||6||164||

216.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ੫ ॥
216.t: gauRee maalaa 5 ||
216.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehla:

216.g: ਮਾਧਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
216.t: maadhau har har har mukh kaheeaai ||
216.e: O Lord, I chant Your Name, Har, Har, Har.

216.g: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
216.t: ham te kachhoo na hovai suaamee jiau raakhahu tiau raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
216.e: I cannot do anything by myself, O Lord and Master. As You keep me, so I remain. ||1||Pause||

216.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
216.t: kiaa kichh karai k karanaihaaraa kiaa is haath bichaare ||
216.e: What can the mere mortal do? What is in the hands of this poor creature?

216.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
216.t: jit tum laavahu tit hee laagaa pooran khasam hamaare ||1||
216.e: As You attach us, so we are attached, O my Perfect Lord and Master. ||1||

216.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
216.t: karahu kirapaa sarab ke dhaate ek roop liv laavahu ||
216.e: Take pity on me, O Great Giver of all, that I may enshrine love for Your Form alone.

216.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੫॥
216.t: naanak kee bena(n)tee har peh apunaa naam japaavahu ||2||7||165||
216.e: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||165||

216.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
216.t: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa panjavaa
216.e: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

216.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
216.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
216.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

216.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: dheen dhiaal dhamodhar raiaa jeeau ||
216.e: O Merciful to the meek, O Dear Lord King,

216.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: koT janaa kar sev lagaiaa jeeau ||
216.e: You have engaged millions of people in Your Service.

216.g: ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: bhagat vachhal teraa biradh rakhaiaa jeeau ||
216.e: You are the Lover of Your devotees; this is Your Nature.

216.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
216.t: pooran sabhanee jaiee jeeau ||1||
216.e: You are totally pervading all places. ||1||

216.g: ਕਿਉ ਪੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਵਣ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: kiau pekhaa preetam kavan sukaranee jeeau ||
216.e: How can I behold my Beloved? What is that way of life?

216.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: sa(n)taa dhaasee sevaa charanee jeeau ||
216.e: Become the slave of the Saints, and serve at their feet.

216.g: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਤਾਈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: eih jeeau vataiee bal bal jaiee jeeau ||
216.e: I dedicate this soul; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

216.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
216.t: tis niv niv laagau paiee jeeau ||2||
216.e: Bowing low, I fall at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

216.g: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਖੋਜੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: pothee pa(n)ddit bedh khoja(n)taa jeeau ||
216.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, study the books of the Vedas.

216.g: ਹੋਇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: hoi bairaagee teerath naava(n)taa jeeau ||
216.e: Some become renunciates, and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

216.g: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: geet naadh keeratan gaava(n)taa jeeau ||
216.e: Some sing tunes and melodies and songs.

216.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
216.t: har nirabhau naam dhiaaiee jeeau ||3||
216.e: But I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord. ||3||

216.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: bhe kirapaal suaamee mere jeeau ||
216.e: My Lord and Master has become merciful to me.

216.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.t: patit pavit lag gur ke paire jeeau ||
216.e: I was a sinner, and I have been sanctified, taking to the Guru's Feet.

217.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: bhram bhau kaaT ke'ee niravaire jeeau ||
217.e: Dispelling my doubts and fears, the Guru has rid me of hatred.

217.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
217.t: gur man kee aas pooraiee jeeau ||4||
217.e: The Guru has fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||4||

217.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: jin naau paiaa so dhanava(n)taa jeeau ||
217.e: One who has obtained the Name is wealthy.

217.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: jin prabh dhiaaiaa su sobhaava(n)taa jeeau ||
217.e: One who meditates on God is glorified.

217.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: jis saadhoo sa(n)gat tis sabh sukaranee jeeau ||
217.e: Sublime are all the actions of those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

217.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੬੬॥
217.t: jan naanak sahaj samaiee jeeau ||5||1||166||
217.e: Servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||5||1||166||

217.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਝ ॥
217.t: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa maajh ||
217.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla, Maajh:

217.g: ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: aau hamaarai raam piaare jeeau ||
217.e: Come to me, O my Beloved Lord.

217.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: rain dhinas saas saas chitaare jeeau ||
217.e: Night and day, with each and every breath, I think of You.

217.g: ਸੰਤ ਦੇਉ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ਪੈ ਚਰਣਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: sa(n)t dheau sa(n)dhesaa pai charanaare jeeau ||
217.e: O Saints, give Him this message; I fall at Your Feet.

217.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
217.t: tudh bin kit bidh tareeaai jeeau ||1||
217.e: Without You, how can I be saved? ||1||

217.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: sa(n)g tumaarai mai kare ana(n)dhaa jeeau ||
217.e: In Your Company, I am in ecstasy.

217.g: ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: van tin tirabhavan sukh paramaana(n)dhaa jeeau ||
217.e: In the forest, the fields and the three worlds, there is peace and supreme bliss.

217.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: sej suhaavee ih man bigasa(n)dhaa jeeau ||
217.e: My bed is beautiful, and my mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

217.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
217.t: pekh dharasan ih sukh laheeaai jeeau ||2||
217.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have found this peace. ||2||

217.g: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: charan pakhaar karee nit sevaa jeeau ||
217.e: I wash Your Feet, and constantly serve You.

217.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dhan dhevaa jeeau ||
217.e: O Divine Lord, I worship and adore You; I bow down before You.

217.g: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: dhaasan dhaas naam jap levaa jeeau ||
217.e: I am the slave of Your slaves; I chant Your Name.

217.g: ਬਿਨਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
217.t: binau Thaakur peh kaheeaai jeeau ||3||
217.e: I offer this prayer to my Lord and Master. ||3||

217.g: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: eichh pu(n)nee meree man tan hariaa jeeau ||
217.e: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind and body are rejuvenated.

217.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: dharasan pekhat sabh dhukh parahariaa jeeau ||
217.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all my pains have been taken away.

217.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: har har naam jape jap tariaa jeeau ||
217.e: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been saved.

217.g: ਇਹੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੭॥
217.t: eih ajar naanak sukh saheeaai jeeau ||4||2||167||
217.e: Nanak endures this unendurable celestial bliss. ||4||2||167||

217.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
217.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
217.e: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

217.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: sun sun saajan man mit piaare jeeau ||
217.e: Listen, listen, O my friend and companion, O Beloved of my mind:

217.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਿ ਵਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: man tan teraa ih jeeau bh vaare jeeau ||
217.e: my mind and body are Yours. This life is a sacrifice to You as well.

217.g: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: visar naahee prabh praan adhaare jeeau ||
217.e: May I never forget God, the Support of the breath of life.

217.g: ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
217.t: sadhaa teree saranaiee jeeau ||1||
217.e: I have come to Your Eternal Sanctuary. ||1||

217.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: jis miliaai man jeevai bhaiee jeeau ||
217.e: Meeting Him, my mind is revived, O Siblings of Destiny.

217.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: gur parasaadhee so har har paiee jeeau ||
217.e: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Lord, Har, Har.

217.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: sabh kichh prabh kaa prabh keeaa jaiee jeeau ||
217.e: All things belong to God; all places belong to God.

217.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
217.t: prabh kau sadh bal jaiee jeeau ||2||
217.e: I am forever a sacrifice to God. ||2||

217.g: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: eh nidhaan japai vaddabhaagee jeeau ||
217.e: Very fortunate are those who meditate on this treasure.

217.g: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: naam nira(n)jan ek liv laagee jeeau ||
217.e: They enshrine love for the Naam, the Name of the One Immaculate Lord.

217.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: gur pooraa paiaa sabh dhukh miTaiaa jeeau ||
217.e: Finding the Perfect Guru, all suffering is dispelled.

217.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
217.t: aaTh pahar gun gaiaa jeeau ||3||
217.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glories of God. ||3||

217.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: ratan padhaarath har naam tumaaraa jeeau ||
217.e: Your Name is the treasure of jewels, Lord.

217.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: too(n) sachaa saahu bhagat vanajaaraa jeeau ||
217.e: You are the True Banker; Your devotee is the trader.

217.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.t: har dhan raas sach vaapaaraa jeeau ||
217.e: True is the trade of those who have the wealth of the Lord's assets.

217.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੮॥
217.t: jan naanak sadh balihaaraa jeeau ||4||3||168||
217.e: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||4||3||168||

217.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
217.t: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa panjavaa
217.e: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

217.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
217.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
217.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

217.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
217.t: too(n) meraa bahu maan karate too(n) meraa bahu maan ||
217.e: I am so proud of You, O Creator; I am so proud of You.

217.g: ਜੋਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
217.t: jor tumaarai sukh vasaa sach sabadh neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
217.e: Through Your Almighty Power, I dwell in peace. The True Word of the Shabad is my banner and insignia. ||1||Pause||

217.g: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਚੁਪ ਕੀਆ ॥
217.t: sabhe galaa jaateeaa sun kai chup keeaa ||
217.e: He hears and knows everything, but he keeps silent.

217.g: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
217.t: kadh hee surat na ladheeaa maiaa mohaRiaa ||1||
217.e: Bewitched by Maya, he never regains awareness. ||1||

217.g: ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਰਤ ਸਾਰਤਾ ਸੇ ਅਖੀ ਡਿਠੜਿਆ ॥
217.t: dhei bujhaarat saarataa se akhee ddiThaRiaa ||
217.e: The riddles and hints are given, and he sees them with his eyes.

218.g: ਕੋਈ ਜਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
218.t: koiee j moorakh lobheeaa mool na sunee kahiaa ||2||
218.e: But he is foolish and greedy, and he never listens to what he is told. ||2||

218.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਸਭ ਇਕਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਠੀ ॥
218.t: eikas dhuh chahu kiaa ganee sabh ikat saadh muThee ||
218.e: Why bother to count one, two, three, four? The whole world is defrauded by the same enticements.

218.g: ਇਕੁ ਅਧੁ ਨਾਇ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ ਕਾ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਵੁਠੀ ॥੩॥
218.t: eik adh nai raseeaRaa kaa viralee jai vuThee ||3||
218.e: Hardly anyone loves the Lord's Name; how rare is that place which is in bloom. ||3||

218.g: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
218.t: bhagat sache dhar sohadhe anadh kareh dhin raat ||
218.e: The devotees look beautiful in the True Court; night and day, they are happy.

218.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
218.t: ra(n)g rate paramesarai jan naanak tin bal jaat ||4||1||169||
218.e: They are imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||4||1||169||

218.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਂਝ ॥
218.t: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa maa(n)jh ||
218.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla, Maajh:

218.g: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
218.t: dhukh bha(n)jan teraa naam jee dhukh bha(n)jan teraa naam ||
218.e: The Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name, Lord; the Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name.

218.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
218.t: aaTh pahar aaraadheeaai pooran satigur giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
218.e: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the wisdom of the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

218.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
218.t: jit ghaT vasai paarabraham soiee suhaavaa thaau ||
218.e: That heart, in which the Supreme Lord God abides, is the most beautiful place.

218.g: ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
218.t: jam ka(n)kar neR na aaviee rasanaa har gun gaau ||1||
218.e: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with the tongue. ||1||

218.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
218.t: sevaa surat na jaaneeaa naa jaapai aaraadh ||
218.e: I have not understood the wisdom of serving Him, nor have I worshipped Him in meditation.

218.g: ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
218.t: oT teree jagajeevanaa mere Thaakur agam agaadh ||2||
218.e: You are my Support, O Life of the World; O my Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. ||2||

218.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਨਠੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
218.t: bhe kirapaal gusaieeaa naThe sog sa(n)taap ||
218.e: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful, sorrow and suffering departed.

218.g: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
218.t: tatee vaau na lagiee satigur rakhe aap ||3||
218.e: The hot winds do not even touch those who are protected by the True Guru. ||3||

218.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਦਯੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
218.t: gur naarain dhay gur gur sachaa sirajanahaar ||
218.e: The Guru is the All-pervading Lord, the Guru is the Merciful Master; the Guru is the True Creator Lord.

218.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
218.t: gur tuThai sabh kichh paiaa jan naanak sadh balihaar ||4||2||170||
218.e: When the Guru was totally satisfied, I obtained everything. Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||2||170||

218.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
218.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
218.e: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

218.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
218.t: har raam raam raam raamaa ||
218.e: The Lord, the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam:

218.g: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
218.t: jap pooran hoe kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
218.e: meditating on Him, all affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

218.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪੇਦਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
218.t: raam gobi(n)dh japedhiaa hoaa mukh pavitr ||
218.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, one's mouth is sanctified.

218.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥੧॥
218.t: har jas suneeaai jis te soiee bhaiee mitr ||1||
218.e: One who recites to me the Praises of the Lord is my friend and brother. ||1||

218.g: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਫਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
218.t: sabh padhaarath sabh falaa sarab gunaa jis maeh ||
218.e: All treasures, all rewards and all virtues are in the Lord of the Universe.

218.g: ਕਿਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
218.t: kiau gobi(n)dh manahu visaareeaai jis simarat dhukh jaeh ||2||
218.e: Why forget Him from your mind? Remembering Him in meditation, pain departs. ||2||

218.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਗਿਐ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਈਐ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
218.t: jis laR lagiaai jeeveeaai bhavajal pieeaai paar ||
218.e: Grasping the hem of His robe, we live, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

218.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
218.t: mil saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar hoi mukh uoojal dharabaar ||3||
218.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

218.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
218.t: jeevan roop gopaal jas sa(n)t janaa kee raas ||
218.e: The Praise of the Sustainer of the Universe is the essence of life, and the wealth of His Saints.

218.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
218.t: naanak ubare naam jap dhar sachai saabaas ||4||3||171||
218.e: Nanak is saved, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in the True Court, he is cheered and applauded. ||4||3||171||

218.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
218.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
218.e: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

218.g: ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
218.t: meeThe har gun gaau ji(n)dhoo too(n) meeThe har gun gaau ||
218.e: Sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord, O my soul, sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord.

218.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
218.t: sache setee ratiaa miliaa nithaave thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
218.e: Attuned to the True One, even the homeless find a home. ||1||Pause||

218.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
218.t: hor saadh sabh fikiaa tan man fikaa hoi ||
218.e: All other tastes are bland and insipid; through them, the body and mind are rendered insipid as well.

218.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
218.t: vin paramesar jo kare fiTu su jeevan soi ||1||
218.e: Without the Transcendent Lord, what can anyone do? Cursed is his life, and cursed his reputation. ||1||

218.g: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਤਰਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
218.t: a(n)chal geh kai saadh kaa taranaa ih sa(n)saar ||
218.e: Grasping the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint, we cross over the world-ocean.

218.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
218.t: paarabraham aaraadheeaai udharai sabh paravaar ||2||
218.e: Worship and adore the Supreme Lord God, and all your family will be saved as well. ||2||

218.g: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
218.t: saajan ba(n)dh sumitr so har naam hiradhai dhei ||
218.e: He is a companion, a relative, and a good friend of mine, who implants the Lord's Name within my heart.

218.g: ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
218.t: aaugan sabh miTai kai paraupakaar karei ||3||
218.e: He washes off all my demerits, and is so generous to me. ||3||

218.g: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
218.t: maal khajaanaa theh ghar har ke charan nidhaan ||
218.e: Wealth, treasures, and household are all just ruins; the Lord's Feet are the only treasure.

218.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
218.t: naanak jaachak dhar terai prabh tudhano ma(n)gai dhaan ||4||4||172||
218.e: Nanak is a beggar standing at Your Door, God; he begs for Your charity. ||4||4||172||

219.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
219.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
219.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

219.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
219.t: raag gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
219.e: Raag Gauree, Ninth Mehla

219.g: ਸਾਧੋ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
219.t: saadho man kaa maan tiaagau ||
219.e: : Holy Saadhus: forsake the pride of your mind.

219.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.t: kaam karodh sa(n)gat dhurajan kee taa te ahinis bhaagau ||1|| rahaau ||
219.e: Sexual desire, anger and the company of evil people - run away from them, day and night. ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੋਨੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥
219.t: sukh dhukh dhono sam kar jaanai aaur maan apamaanaa ||
219.e: One who knows that pain and pleasure are both the same, and honor and dishonor as well,

219.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
219.t: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa tin jag tat pachhaanaa ||1||
219.e: who remains detached from joy and sorrow, realizes the true essence in the world. ||1||

219.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਖੋਜੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
219.t: ausatat ni(n)dhaa dhouoo tiaagai khojai padh nirabaanaa ||
219.e: Renounce both praise and blame; seek instead the state of Nirvaanaa.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਠਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
219.t: jan naanak ih khel kaThan hai kinahoo(n) gurmukh jaanaa ||2||1||
219.e: O servant Nanak, this is such a difficult game; only a few Gurmukhs understand it! ||2||1||

219.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
219.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
219.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

219.g: ਸਾਧੋ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
219.t: saadho rachanaa raam banaiee ||
219.e: Holy Saadhus: the Lord fashioned the creation.

219.g: ਇਕਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਇਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.t: eik binasai ik asathir maanai acharaj lakhio na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
219.e: One person passes away, and another thinks that he will live forever - this is a wonder beyond understanding! ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ਬਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
219.t: kaam karodh moh bas praanee har moorat bisaraiee ||
219.e: The mortal beings are held in the power of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; they have forgotten the Lord, the Immortal Form.

219.g: ਝੂਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
219.t: jhooThaa tan saachaa kar maanio jiau supanaa rainaiee ||1||
219.e: The body is false, but they believe it to be true; it is like a dream in the night. ||1||

219.g: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਈ ॥
219.t: jo dheesai so sagal binaasai jiau baadhar kee chhaiee ||
219.e: Whatever is seen, shall all pass away, like the shadow of a cloud.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
219.t: jan naanak jag jaanio mithiaa rahio raam saranaiee ||2||2||
219.e: O servant Nanak, one who knows the world to be unreal, dwells in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||2||

219.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
219.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
219.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

219.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
219.t: praanee kau har jas man nahee aavai ||
219.e: The Praise of the Lord does not come to dwell in the minds of the mortal beings.

219.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.t: ahinis magan rahai maiaa mai kahu kaise gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
219.e: Day and night, they remain engrossed in Maya. Tell me, how can they sing God's Glories? ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਪੂਤ ਮੀਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
219.t: poot meet maiaa mamataa siau ieh bidh aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
219.e: In this way, they bind themselves to children, friends, Maya and possessiveness.

219.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਝੂਠੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਾਸਿ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
219.t: mirag tirasanaa jiau jhooTho ih jag dhekh taas uTh dhaavai ||1||
219.e: Like the deer's delusion, this world is false; and yet, beholding it, they chase after it. ||1||

219.g: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੂੜ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
219.t: bhugat mukat kaa kaaran suaamee mooR taeh bisaraavai ||
219.e: Our Lord and Master is the source of pleasures and liberation; and yet, the fool forgets Him.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕੋਊ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
219.t: jan naanak koTan mai kouoo bhajan raam ko paavai ||2||3||
219.e: O servant Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely anyone who attains the Lord's meditation. ||2||3||

219.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
219.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
219.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

219.g: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
219.t: saadho ih man gahio na jaiee ||
219.e: Holy Saadhus: this mind cannot be restrained.

219.g: ਚੰਚਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.t: cha(n)chal tirasanaa sa(n)g basat hai yaa te thir na rahaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
219.e: Fickle desires dwell with it, and so it cannot remain steady. ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਕਠਨ ਕਰੋਧ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
219.t: kaThan karodh ghaT hee ke bheetar jeh sudh sabh bisaraiee ||
219.e: The heart is filled with anger and violence, which cause all sense to be forgotten.

219.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
219.t: ratan giaan sabh ko hir leenaa taa siau kachh na basaiee ||1||
219.e: The jewel of spiritual wisdom has been taken away from everyone; nothing can withstand it. ||1||

219.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੁਨੀ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
219.t: jogee jatan karat sabh haare gunee rahe gun gaiee ||
219.e: The Yogis have tried everything and failed; the virtuous have grown weary of singing God's Glories.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤਉ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੨॥੪॥
219.t: jan naanak har bhe dhiaalaa tau sabh bidh ban aaiee ||2||4||
219.e: O servant Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then every effort is successful. ||2||4||

219.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
219.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
219.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

219.g: ਸਾਧੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
219.t: saadho gobi(n)dh ke gun gaavau ||
219.e: Holy Saadhus: sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

219.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.t: maanas janam amolak paio birathaa kaeh gavaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
219.e: You have obtained the priceless jewel of this human life; why are you uselessly wasting it? ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਆਵਉ ॥
219.t: patit puneet dheen ba(n)dh har saran taeh tum aavau ||
219.e: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Friend of the poor. Come, and enter the Lord's Sanctuary.

219.g: ਗਜ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
219.t: gaj ko traas miTio jeh simarat tum kaahe bisaraavau ||1||
219.e: Remembering Him, the elephant's fear was removed; so why do you forget Him? ||1||

219.g: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਭਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
219.t: taj abhimaan moh maiaa fun bhajan raam chit laavau ||
219.e: Renounce your egotistical pride and your emotional attachment to Maya; focus your consciousness on the Lord's meditation.

219.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
219.t: naanak kahat mukat pa(n)th ih gurmukh hoi tum paavau ||2||5||
219.e: Says Nanak, this is the path to liberation. Become Gurmukh, and attain it. ||2||5||

219.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
219.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
219.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

219.g: ਕੋਊ ਮਾਈ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
219.t: kouoo maiee bhoolio man samajhaavai ||
219.e: O mother, if only someone would instruct my wayward mind.

220.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਧ ਮਗ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.t: bedh puraan saadh mag sun kar nimakh na har gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
220.e: This mind listens to the Vedas, the Puraanas, and the ways of the Holy Saints, but it does not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, for even an instant. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥
220.t: dhuralabh dheh pai maanas kee birathaa janam siraavai ||
220.e: Having obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain, it is now being uselessly wasted.

220.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
220.t: maiaa moh mahaa sa(n)kaT ban taa siau ruch upajaavai ||1||
220.e: Emotional attachment to Maya is such a treacherous wilderness, and yet, people are in love with it. ||1||

220.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
220.t: a(n)tar baahar sadhaa sa(n)g prabh taa siau neh na laavai ||
220.e: Inwardly and outwardly, God is always with them, and yet, they do not enshrine Love for Him.

220.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬॥
220.t: naanak mukat taeh tum maanahu jeh ghaT raam samaavai ||2||6||
220.e: O Nanak, know that those whose hearts are filled with the Lord are liberated. ||2||6||

220.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
220.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
220.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

220.g: ਸਾਧੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
220.t: saadho raam saran bisaraamaa ||
220.e: Holy Saadhus: rest and peace are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

220.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪੜੇ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਗੁਨ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.t: bedh puraan paRe ko ieh gun simare har ko naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
220.e: This is the blessing of studying the Vedas and the Puraanas, that you may meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਅਉ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਪਰਸੈ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
220.t: lobh moh maiaa mamataa fun aau bikhian kee sevaa || harakh sog parasai jeh naahan so moorat hai dhevaa ||1||
220.e: Greed, emotional attachment to Maya, possessiveness, the service of evil, pleasure and pain - those who are not touched by these, are the very embodiment of the Divine Lord. ||1||

220.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੁ ਏ ਸਭ ਤਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਰੁ ਪੈਸਾ ॥
220.t: surag narak a(n)mirat bikh e sabh tiau ka(n)chan ar paisaa ||
220.e: Heaven and hell, ambrosial nectar and poison, gold and copper - these are all alike to them.

220.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਏ ਸਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੨॥
220.t: ausatat ni(n)dhaa e sam jaa kai lobh moh fun taisaa ||2||
220.e: Praise and slander are all the same to them, as are greed and attachment. ||2||

220.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਏ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
220.t: dhukh sukh e baadhe jeh naahan teh tum jaanau giaanee ||
220.e: They are not bound by pleasure and pain - know that they are truly wise.

220.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
220.t: naanak mukat taeh tum maanau ieh bidh ko jo praanee ||3||7||
220.e: O Nanak, recognize those mortal beings as liberated, who live this way of life. ||3||7||

220.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
220.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
220.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

220.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
220.t: man re kahaa bhio tai bauraa ||
220.e: O mind, why have you gone crazy?

220.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਭਇਓ ਲੋਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.t: ahinis aaudh ghaTai nahee jaanai bhio lobh sa(n)g hauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
220.e: Don't you know that your life is decreasing, day and night? Your life is made worthless with greed. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਤੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
220.t: jo tan tai apano kar maanio ar su(n)dhar gireh naaree ||
220.e: That body, which you believe to be your own, and your beautiful home and spouse

220.g: ਇਨ ਮੈਂ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਦੇਖੋ ਸੋਚ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
220.t: ein mai(n) kachh tero re naahan dhekho soch bichaaree ||1||
220.e: - none of these is yours to keep. See this, reflect upon it and understand. ||1||

220.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
220.t: ratan janam apano tai haario gobi(n)dh gat nahee jaanee ||
220.e: You have wasted the precious jewel of this human life; you do not know the Way of the Lord of the Universe.

220.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਚਰਨਨ ਸਿਂਉ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
220.t: nimakh na leen bhio charanan si(n)au birathaa aaudh siraanee ||2||
220.e: You have not been absorbed in the Lord's Feet, even for an instant. Your life has passed away in vain! ||2||

220.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
220.t: kahu naanak soiee nar sukheeaa raam naam gun gaavai ||
220.e: Says Nanak, that man is happy, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

220.g: ਅਉਰ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥
220.t: aaur sagal jag maiaa mohiaa nirabhai padh nahee paavai ||3||8||
220.e: All the rest of the world is enticed by Maya; they do not obtain the state of fearless dignity. ||3||8||

220.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
220.t: gauRee mahalaa nauvaa ||
220.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehla:

220.g: ਨਰ ਅਚੇਤ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਡਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
220.t: nar achet paap te ddar re ||
220.e: You people are unconscious; you should be afraid of sin.

220.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.t: dheen dhiaal sagal bhai bha(n)jan saran taeh tum par re ||1|| rahaau ||
220.e: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of all fear. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਾਸ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੀਐ ਮੋ ਧਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
220.t: bedh puraan jaas gun gaavat taa ko naam heeaai mo dhar re ||
220.e: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing His Praises; enshrine His Name within your heart.

220.g: ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
220.t: paavan naam jagat mai har ko simar simar kasamal sabh har re ||1||
220.e: Pure and sublime is the Name of the Lord in the world. Remembering it in meditation, all sinful mistakes shall be washed away. ||1||

220.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਛੂ ਉਪਾਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
220.t: maanas dheh bahur neh paavai kachhoo upaau mukat kaa kar re ||
220.e: You shall not obtain this human body again; make the effort - try to achieve liberation!

220.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਗਾਇ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਮੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੫੧॥
220.t: naanak kahat gai karunaa mai bhav saagar kai paar utar re ||2||9||251||
220.e: Says Nanak, sing of the Lord of compassion, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||9||251||

220.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ
220.t: raag gauRee asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa gauRee guaareree
220.e: Raag Gauree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla: Gauree Gwaarayree:

220.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
220.t: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
220.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

220.g: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
220.t: nidh sidh niramal naam beechaar ||
220.e: The nine treasures and the miraculous spiritual powers come by contemplating the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

220.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
220.t: pooran poor rahiaa bikh maar ||
220.e: The Perfect Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He destroys the poison of Maya.

220.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
220.t: tirakuTee chhooTee bimal majhaar ||
220.e: I am rid of the three-phased Maya, dwelling in the Pure Lord.

221.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਇ ਆਈ ਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
221.t: gur kee mat jeei aaiee kaar ||1||
221.e: The Guru's Teachings are useful to my soul. ||1||

221.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
221.t: ein bidh raam ramat man maaniaa ||
221.e: Chanting the Lord's Name in this way, my mind is satisfied.

221.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
221.t: giaan a(n)jan gur sabadh pachhaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
221.e: I have obtained the ointment of spiritual wisdom, recognizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
Blended with the One Lord, I enjoy intuitive peace.
Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, my doubts have been dispelled.
Instead of the pale color of Maya, I am imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.
By the Lord's Glance of Grace, the poison has been eliminated. ||2||
When I turned away, and became dead while yet alive, I was awakened.

221.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
221.t: sabadh rave man har siau laagiaa ||
221.e: Chanting the Word of the Shabad, my mind is attached to the Lord.
I have gathered in the Lord's sublime essence, and cast out the poison.

221.g: ਭਾਇ ਬਸੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ॥੩॥
221.t: bhai base jam kaa bhau bhaagiaa ||3||
221.e: Abiding in His Love, the fear of death has run away. ||3||
My taste for pleasure ended, along with conflict and egotism.

221.g: ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
221.t: chit har siau raataa hukam apaaraa ||
221.e: My consciousness is attuned to the Lord, by the Order of the Infinite.
My pursuit for worldy pride and honour is over.
When He blessed me with His Glance of Grace, peace was established in my soul. ||4||

221.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
221.t: tujh bin koi na dhekhau meet ||
221.e: Without You, I see no friend at all.
Whom should I serve? Unto whom should I dedicate my consciousness?
Whom should I ask? At whose feet should I fall?
By whose teachings will I remain absorbed in His Love? ||5||
I serve the Guru, and I fall at the Guru's Feet.
I worship Him, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name.
The Lord's Love is my instruction, sermon and food.
Enjoined to the Lord's Command, I have entered the home of my inner self. ||6||
With the extinction of pride, my soul has found peace and meditation.
The Divine Light has dawned, and I am absorbed in the Light.
Pre-ordained destiny cannot be erased; the Shabad is my banner and insignia.
I know the Creator, the Creator of His Creation. ||7||
I am not a learned Pandit, I am not clever or wise.
I do not wander; I am not deluded by doubt.
I do not speak empty speech; I have recognized the Hukam of His Command.
Nanak is absorbed in intuitive peace through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||1||
Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla:
The mind is an elephant in the forest of the body.

221.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ ॥ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਭ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
221.t: gur a(n)kas sach sabadh neesaanai || raaj dhuaarai sobh su maanai ||1||
221.e: The Guru is the controlling stick; when the Insignia of the True Shabad is applied, one obtains honor in the Court of God the King. ||1||
He cannot be known through clever tricks.

221.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
221.t: bin maare kiau keemat pai ||1|| rahaau ||
221.e: Without subduing the mind, how can His value be estimated? ||1||Pause||
In the house of the self is the Ambrosial Nectar, which is being stolen by the thieves.
No one can say no to them.
He Himself protects us, and blesses us with greatness. ||2||
There are billions, countless billions of fires of desire at the seat of the mind.
They are extinguished only with the water of understanding, imparted by the Guru.

221.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੀਆ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
221.t: man dhe leeaa rahas gun gaiee ||3||
221.e: Offering my mind, I have attained it, and I joyfully sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||
Just as He is within the home of the self, so is He beyond.
But how can I describe Him, sitting in a cave?
The Fearless Lord is in the oceans, just as He is in the mountains. ||4||
Tell me, who can kill someone who is already dead?
What does he fear? Who can frighten the fearless one?
He recognizes the Word of the Shabad, throughout the three worlds. ||5||
One who speaks, merely describes speech.
But one who understands, intuitively realizes.
Seeing and reflecting upon it, my mind surrenders. ||6||
Praise, beauty and liberation are in the One Name.
In it, the Immaculate Lord is permeating and pervading.

221.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
221.t: nij ghar biaap rahiaa nij Thaiee ||7||
221.e: He dwells in the home of the self, and in His own sublime place. ||7||
The many silent sages lovingly praise Him.

222.g: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
222.t: tan man soochai saachu su cheet ||
222.e: Their bodies and minds are purified, as they enshrine the True Lord in their consciousness.
O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, each and every day. ||8||2||
Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla:

222.g: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
222.t: naa man marai na kaaraj hoi ||
222.e: The mind does not die, so the job is not accomplished.
The mind is under the power of the demons of evil intellect and duality.

222.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
222.t: man maanai gur te ik hoi ||1||
222.e: But when the mind surrenders, through the Guru, it becomes one. ||1||
The Lord is without attributes; the attributes of virtue are under His control.
One who eliminates selfishness contemplates Him. ||1||Pause||
The deluded mind thinks of all sorts of corruption.
When the mind is deluded, the load of wickedness falls on the head.
But when the mind surrenders to the Lord, it realizes the One and Only Lord. ||2||
The deluded mind enters the house of Maya.
Engrossed in sexual desire, it does not remain steady.
O mortal, lovingly vibrate the Lord's Name with your tongue. ||3||
Elephants, horses, gold, children and spouses
in the anxious affairs of all these, people lose the game and depart.
In the game of chess, their pieces do not reach their destination. ||4||
They gather wealth, but only evil comes from it.
Pleasure and pain stand in the doorway.
Intuitive peace comes by meditating on the Lord, within the heart. ||5||
When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites us in His Union.
Through the Word of the Shabad, merits are gathered in, and demerits are burned away.
The Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
Without the Name, all live in pain.
The consciousness of the foolish, self-willed manmukh is the dwelling place of Maya.
The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, according to pre-ordained destiny. ||7||
The fickle mind continuously runs after fleeting things.
The Pure True Lord is not pleased by filth.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||3||
Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla:
Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained.
The intellect of the mind is false; only the Lord is True.
All who love duality are ruined.
People act as they are pre-ordained. ||1||
I have seen the world to be such a gambler;

222.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
222.t: sabh sukh maagai naam bisaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
222.e: all beg for peace, but they forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
If the Unseen Lord could be seen, then He could be described.
Without seeing Him, all descriptions are useless.
The Gurmukh sees Him with intuitive ease.
So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness. ||2||
People beg for peace, but they receive severe pain.
They are all weaving a wreath of corruption.

222.g: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
222.t: ek binaa jhooThe mukat na hoi ||
222.e: You are false - without the One, there is no liberation.
The Creator created the creation, and He watches over it. ||3||
The fire of desire is quenched by the Word of the Shabad.
Duality and doubt are automatically eliminated.
Following the Guru's Teachings, the Naam abides in the heart.
Through the True Word of His Bani, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||
The True Lord abides within the body of that Gurmukh who enshrines love for Him.
Without the Naam, none obtain their own place.
The Beloved Lord King is dedicated to love.
If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then we realize His Name. ||5||
Emotional attachment to Maya is total entanglement.
The self-willed manmukh is filthy, cursed and dreadful.
Serving the True Guru, these entanglements are ended.
In the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, you shall abide in lasting peace. ||6||
The Gurmukhs understand the One Lord, and enshrine love for Him.
They dwell in the home of their own inner beings, and merge in the True Lord.
The cycle of birth and death is ended.

222.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
222.t: poore gur te ieh mat paae ||7||
222.e: This understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||7||
Speaking the speech, there is no end to it.

223.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
223.t: gur puchh dhekhiaa naahee dhar hor ||
223.e: I have consulted the Guru, and I have seen that there is no other door than His.
Pain and pleasure reside in the Pleasure of His Will and His Command.
Nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord. ||8||4||
Gauree, First Mehla:
The duality of Maya dwells in the consciousness of the people of the world.
They are destroyed by sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||1||
Whom should I call the second, when there is only the One?

223.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
223.t: sabh meh ek nira(n)jan soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
223.e: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading among all. ||1||Pause||
The dual-minded evil intellect speaks of a second.
One who harbors duality comes and goes and dies. ||2||
In the earth and in the sky, I do not see any second.
Among all the women and the men, His Light is shining. ||3||
In the lamps of the sun and the moon, I see His Light.
Dwelling among all is my ever-youthful Beloved. ||4||
In His Mercy, He attuned my consciousness to the Lord.
The True Guru has led me to understand the One Lord. ||5||
The Gurmukh knows the One Immaculate Lord.
Subduing duality, one comes to realize the Word of the Shabad. ||6||
The Command of the One Lord prevails throughout all the worlds.
From the One, all have arisen. ||7||
There are two routes, but remember that their Lord and Master is only One.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||8||
He is contained in all forms, colors and minds.
Says Nanak, praise the One Lord. ||9||5||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Those who live a spiritual lifestyle - they alone are true.
What can the false know about the secrets of liberation? ||1||
Those who contemplate the Way are Yogis.

223.g: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
223.t: pa(n)ch maar saach ur dhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
223.e: They conquer the five thieves, and enshrine the True Lord in the heart. ||1||Pause||
Those who enshrine the True Lord deep within,
realize the value of the Way of Yoga. ||2||
The sun and the moon are one and the same for them, as are household and wilderness.
The karma of their daily practice is to praise the Lord. ||3||
They beg for the alms of the one and only Shabad.
They remain awake and aware in spiritual wisdom and meditation, and the true way of life. ||4||

223.g: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
223.t: bhai rach rahai na baahar jai ||
223.e: They remain absorbed in the fear of God; they never leave it.
Who can estimate their value? They remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
The Lord unites them with Himself, dispelling their doubts.
By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained. ||6||
In the Guru's service is reflection upon the Shabad.
Subduing ego, practice pure actions. ||7||
Chanting, meditation, austere self-discipline and the reading of the Puraanas,
says Nanak, are contained in surrender to the Unlimited Lord. ||8||6||
Gauree, First Mehla:
To practice forgiveness is the true fast, good conduct and contentment.

223.g: ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾ ਜਮ ਦੋਖੰ ॥
223.t: rog na biaapai naa jam dhokha(n) ||
223.e: Disease does not afflict me, nor does the pain of death.

223.g: ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥੧॥
223.t: mukat bhe prabh roop na rekha(n) ||1||
223.e: I am liberated, and absorbed into God, who has no form or feature. ||1||
What fear does the Yogi have?

223.g: ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
223.t: rookh birakh gireh baahar soi ||1|| rahaau ||
223.e: The Lord is among the trees and the plants, within the household and outside as well. ||1||Pause||
The Yogis meditate on the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.
Night and day, they remain awake and aware, embracing love for the True Lord.
Those Yogis are pleasing to my mind. ||2||
The trap of death is burnt by the Fire of God.
Old age, death and pride are conquered.
They swim across, and save their ancestors as well. ||3||
Those who serve the True Guru are the Yogis.

223.g: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
223.t: bhai rach rahai su nirabhau hoi ||
223.e: Those who remain immersed in the Fear of God become fearless.
They become just like the One they serve. ||4||

224.e: The Name makes a man pure and fearless.
It makes the masterless become the master of all. I am a sacrifice to him.
Such a person is not reincarnated again; he sings the Glories of God. ||5||
Inwardly and outwardly, he knows the One Lord;
through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he realizes himself.
He bears the Banner and Insignia of the True Shabad in the Lord's Court. ||6||

224.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
224.t: sabadh marai tis nij ghar vaasaa ||
224.e: One who dies in the Shabad abides in his own home within.
He does not come or go in reincarnation, and his hopes are subdued.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||7||
Whoever is seen, is driven by hope and despair,
by sexual desire, anger, corruption, hunger and thirst.
O Nanak, those detached recluses who meet the Lord are so very rare. ||8||7||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Meeting such a slave, peace is obtained.
Pain is forgotten, when the True Lord is found. ||1||
Beholding the blessed vision of his darshan, my understanding has become perfect.
The cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are in the dust of his feet. ||1||Pause||
My eyes are contented with the constant love of the One Lord.
My tongue is purified by the most sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
True are my actions, and deep within my being, I serve Him.
My mind is satisfied by the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||3||

224.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
224.t: jeh jeh dhekhau teh teh saachaa ||
224.e: Wherever I look, there I find the True Lord.
Without understanding, the world argues in falsehood. ||4||
When the Guru instructs, understanding is obtained.
How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||5||
Show Your Mercy, and save me, O Savior Lord!
Without understanding, people become beasts and demons. ||6||
The Guru has said that there is no other at all.

224.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
224.t: kis kahu dhekh karau an poojaa ||7||
224.e: So tell me, who should I see, and who should I worship? ||7||
For the sake of the Saints, God has established the three worlds.
One who understands his own soul, contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||
One whose heart is filled with Truth and true love

224.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥੯॥੮॥
224.t: pranavat naanak ham taa ke dhaas ||9||8||
224.e: - prays Nanak, I am his servant. ||9||8||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Brahma acted in pride, and did not understand.
Only when he was faced with the downfall of the Vedas did he repent.

224.g: ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
224.t: jeh prabh simare tahee man maaniaa ||1||
224.e: Remembering God in meditation, the mind is conciliated. ||1||
Such is the horrible pride of the world.

224.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
224.t: jis gur milai tis garab nivaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
224.e: The Guru eliminates the pride of those who meet Him. ||1||Pause||
Bal the King, in Maya and egotism,
held his ceremonial feasts, but he was puffed up with pride.
Without the Guru's advice, he had to go to the underworld. ||2||
Hari Chand gave in charity, and earned public praise.

224.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥
224.t: bin gur a(n)t na pai abhevai ||
224.e: But without the Guru, he did not find the limits of the Mysterious Lord.
The Lord Himself misleads people, and He Himself imparts understanding. ||3||
The evil-minded Harnaakhash committed evil deeds.
God, the Lord of all, is the Destroyer of pride.
He bestowed His Mercy, and saved Prahlaad. ||4||
Raawan was deluded, foolish and unwise.
Sri Lanka was plundered, and he lost his head.
He indulged in ego, and lacked the love of the True Guru. ||5||
The Lord killed the thousand-armed Arjun, and the demons Madhu-keetab and Meh-khaasaa.
He seized Harnaakhash and tore him apart with his nails.
The demons were slain; they did not practice devotional worship. ||6||
The demons Jaraa-sandh and Kaal-jamun were destroyed.
Rakat-beej and Kaal-naym were annihilated.
Slaying the demons, the Lord saved His Saints. ||7||
He Himself, as the True Guru, contemplates the Shabad.

225.e: Because of the love of duality, God killed the demons.
By their true devotion, the Gurmukhs have been saved. ||8||
Sinking down, Durodhan lost his honor.
He did not know the Creator Lord.

225.g: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੯॥
225.t: jan kau dhookh pachai dhukh hoiee ||9||
225.e: One who makes the Lord's humble servant suffer, shall himself suffer and rot. ||9||
Janameja did not know the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Deluded by doubt, how could he find peace?
Making a mistake, for even an instant, you shall regret and repent later on. ||10||
Kansa the King and his warriors Kays and Chandoor had no equals.

225.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
225.t: raam na cheeniaa apanee pat khoiee ||
225.e: But they did not remember the Lord, and they lost their honor.
Without the Lord of the Universe, no one can be saved. ||11||

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
225.t: bin gur garab na meTiaa jai ||
225.e: Without the Guru, pride cannot be eradicated.
Following the Guru's Teachings, one obtains Dharmic faith, composure and the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, singing the Glories of God, His Name is received. ||12||9||
Gauree, First Mehla:
I may anoint my limbs with sandalwood oil.
I may dress up and wear silk and satin clothes.

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
225.t: bin har naam kahaa sukh paavau ||1||
225.e: But without the Lord's Name, where would I find peace? ||1||
So what should I wear? In what clothes should I display myself?

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
225.t: bin jagadhees kahaa sukh paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
225.e: Without the Lord of the Universe, how can I find peace? ||1||Pause||

225.g: ਕਾਨੀ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
225.t: kaanee ku(n)ddal gal moteean kee maalaa ||
225.e: I may wear ear-rings, and a pearl necklace around my neck;
my bed may be adorned with red blankets, flowers and red powder;
but without the Lord of the Universe, where can I search for peace? ||2||
I may have a beautiful woman with fascinating eyes;
she may decorate herself with the sixteen adornments, and make herself appear gorgeous.
But without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, there is only continual suffering. ||3||
In his hearth and home, in his palace, upon his soft and comfortable bed,
day and night, the flower-girls scatter flower petals;

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥੪॥
225.t: bin har naam su dheh dhukhaalee ||4||
225.e: but without the Lord's Name, the body is miserable. ||4||
Horses, elephants, lances, marching bands,
armies, standard bearers, royal attendants and ostentatious displays
- without the Lord of the Universe, these undertakings are all useless. ||5||
He may be called a Siddha, a man of spiritual perfection, and he may summon riches and supernatural powers;
he may place a crown upon his head, and carry a royal umbrella;
but without the Lord of the Universe, where can Truth be found? ||6||
He may be called an emperor, a lord, and a king;
he may give orders - ""Do this now, do this then"" - but this is a false display.

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸਵਰਸਿ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੭॥
225.t: bin gur sabadh na savaras kaajaa ||7||
225.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his works are not accomplished. ||7||
Egotism and possessiveness are dispelled by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
With the Guru's Teachings in my heart, I have come to know the Lord.
Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||8||10||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Those who serve the One Lord, do not know any other.
They abandon the bitter worldly conflicts.

225.g: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
225.t: bhai milai sach saachai sach re ||1||
225.e: Through love and truth, they meet the Truest of the True. ||1||
Such are the humble devotees of the Lord.

225.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
225.t: har gun gai milai mal dhoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
225.e: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and their pollution is washed away. ||1||Pause||
The heart-lotus of the entire universe is upside-down.
The fire of evil-mindedness is burning up the world.
They alone are saved, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
The bumble bee, the moth, the elephant, the fish
and the deer - all suffer for their actions, and die.
Trapped by desire, they cannot see reality. ||3||
The lover of women is obsessed with sex.
All the wicked are ruined by their anger.
Honor and good sense are lost, when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

226.e: The self-willed manmukh is lured by another man's wife.
The noose is around his neck, and he is entangled in petty conflicts.
The Gurmukh is emancipated, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

226.g: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ॥
226.t: jiau tan bidhavaa par kau dheiee ||
226.e: The lonely widow gives her body to a stranger;

226.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਦਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਸੇਈ ॥
226.t: kaam dhaam chit par vas seiee ||
226.e: she allows her mind to be controlled by others for lust or money

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
226.t: bin pir tirapat na kabahoo(n) hoiee ||6||
226.e: , but without her husband, she is never satisfied. ||6||

226.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੋਥੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠਾ ॥ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਾਟਾ ॥
226.t: paR paR pothee si(n)mirat paaThaa || bedh puraan paRai sun thaaTaa ||
226.e: You may read, recite and study the scriptures, the Simritees, Vedas and Puraanas;

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਟਾ ॥੭॥
226.t: bin ras raate man bahu naaTaa ||7||
226.e: but without being imbued with the Lord's essence, the mind wanders endlessly. ||7||
As the rainbird thirsts longingly for the drop of rain,
and as the fish delights in the water,
Nanak is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord. ||8||11||
Gauree, First Mehla:

226.g: ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
226.t: haTh kar marai na lekhai paavai ||
226.e: One who dies in stubbornness shall not be approved,
even though he may wear religious robes and smear his body all over with ashes.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he comes to regret and repent in the end. ||1||

226.g: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਖ ॥
226.t: too(n) man har jeeau too(n) man sookh ||
226.e: Believe in the Dear Lord, and you shall find peace of mind.

226.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
226.t: naam bisaar saheh jam dhookh ||1|| rahaau ||
226.e: Forgetting the Naam, you shall have to endure the pain of death. ||1||Pause||
The smell of musk, sandalwood and camphor,
and the intoxication of Maya, takes one far away from the state of supreme dignity.
Forgetting the Naam, one becomes the most false of all the false. ||2||
Lances and swords, marching bands, thrones and the salutes of others
only increase his desire; he is engrossed in sexual desire.

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
226.t: bin har jaache bhagat na naam ||3||
226.e: Without seeking the Lord, neither devotional worship nor the Naam are obtained. ||3||
Union with God is not obtained by arguments and egotism.
But by offering your mind, the comfort of the Naam is obtained.
In the love of duality and ignorance, you shall suffer. ||4||

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਮ ਕੇ ਸਉਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਟ ॥
226.t: bin dham ke saudhaa nahee haaT ||
226.e: Without money, you cannot buy anything in the store.
Without a boat, you cannot cross over the ocean.
Without serving the Guru, everything is lost. ||5||

226.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਵਾਟ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
226.t: tis kau vaahu vaahu j vaaT dhikhaavai ||
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who shows us the Way.

226.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
226.t: tis kau vaahu vaahu j sabadh sunaavai ||
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who teaches the Word of the Shabad.

226.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
226.t: tis kau vaahu vaahu j mel milaavai ||6||
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who unites me in the Lord's Union. ||6||

226.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
226.t: vaahu vaahu tis kau jis kaa ih jeeau ||
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who is the Keeper of this soul.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate this Ambrosial Nectar.
The Glorious Greatness of the Naam is bestowed according to the Pleasure of Your Will. ||7||
Without the Naam, how can I live, O mother?
Night and day, I chant it; I remain in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, honor is attained. ||8||12||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Acting in egotism, the Lord is not known, even by wearing religious robes.
How rare is that Gurmukh, who surrenders his mind in devotional worship. ||1||

226.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
226.t: hau hau karat nahee sach paieeaai ||
226.e: By actions done in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the True Lord is not obtained.

226.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
226.t: haumai jai param padh paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
226.e: But when egotism departs, then the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||1||Pause||
The kings act in egotism, and undertake all sorts of expeditions.
But through their egotism, they are ruined; they die, only to be reborn over and over again. ||2||
Egotism is overcome only by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
One who restrains his fickle mind subdues the five passions. ||3||
With the True Lord deep within the self, the Celestial Mansion is intuitively found.
Understanding the Sovereign Lord, the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||4||
The Guru dispels the doubts of those whose actions are true.
They focus their attention on the Home of the Fearless Lord. ||5||

226.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
226.t: hau hau kar maranaa kiaa paavai ||
226.e: Those who act in egotism, selfishness and conceit die; what do they gain?

226.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
226.t: pooraa gur bheTe so jhagar chukaavai ||6||
226.e: Those who meet the Perfect Guru are rid of all conflicts. ||6||
Whatever exists, is in reality nothing.
Obtaining spiritual wisdom from the Guru, I sing the Glories of God. ||7||

227.e: Egotism binds people in bondage, and causes them to wander around lost.
O Nanak, peace is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||8||13||
Gauree, First Mehla:
First, Brahma entered the house of Death.
Brahma entered the lotus, and searched the nether regions, but he did not find the end of it.
He did not accept the Lord's Order - he was deluded by doubt. ||1||
Whoever is created, shall be destroyed by Death.

227.g: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
227.t: ham har raakhe gur sabadh beechaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
227.e: But I am protected by the Lord; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
All the gods and goddesses are enticed by Maya.

227.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
227.t: kaal na chhoddai bin gur kee sevaa ||
227.e: Death cannot be avoided, without serving the Guru.
That Lord is Imperishable, Invisible and Inscrutable. ||2||
The sultans, emperors and kings shall not remain.

227.g: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਨਾ ॥
227.t: naamahu bhoolai jam kaa dhukh sahanaa ||
227.e: Forgetting the Name, they shall endure the pain of death.

227.g: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਨਾ ॥੩॥
227.t: mai dhar naam jiau raakhahu rahanaa ||3||
227.e: My only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as He keeps me, I survive. ||3||
The leaders and kings shall not remain.
The bankers shall die, after accumulating their wealth and money.

227.g: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
227.t: mai dhan dheejai har a(n)mirat naam ||4||
227.e: Grant me, O Lord, the wealth of Your Ambrosial Naam. ||4||
The people, rulers, leaders and chiefs
none of them shall be able to remain in the world.
Death is inevitable; it strikes the heads of the false. ||5||
Only the One Lord, the Truest of the True, is permanent.

227.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
227.t: jin kar saajee tineh sabh goiee ||
227.e: He who created and fashioned everything, shall destroy it.

227.g: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
227.t: oh gurmukh jaapai taa(n) pat hoiee ||6||
227.e: One who becomes Gurmukh and meditates on the Lord is honored. ||6||
The Qazis, Shaykhs and Fakeers in religious robes
call themselves great; but through their egotism, their bodies are suffering in pain.

227.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੭॥
