263.t: prabh kai simaran naahee jam traasaa ||
263.e: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
263.t: prabh kai simaran man kee mal jai ||
263.e: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
263.t: prabh jee baseh saadh kee rasanaa ||
263.e: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.
Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||
Those who remember God are wealthy.
Those who remember God are honorable.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh se jan paravaan ||
263.e: Those who remember God are approved.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh se purakh pradhaan ||
263.e: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.
Those who remember God are not lacking.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh s sarab ke raaje ||
263.e: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.
Those who remember God dwell in peace.
Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

263.g: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
263.t: simaran te laage jin aap dhiaalaa ||
263.e: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.
Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||
Those who remember God generously help others.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh tin sadh balihaaree ||
263.e: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh se mukh suhaave ||
263.e: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh tin sookh bihaavai ||
263.e: Those who remember God abide in peace.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh tin aatam jeetaa ||
263.e: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh tin niramal reetaa ||
263.e: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh tin anadh ghanere ||
263.e: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
263.t: prabh kau simareh baseh har nere ||
263.e: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.
By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||
Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
263.t: prabh kai simaran kabahu na jhoore ||
263.e: Remembering God, one never grieves.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
263.t: prabh kai simaran har gun baanee ||
263.e: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.
Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.
Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

263.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
263.t: sukh prabh simaran kaa a(n)t na paar ||
263.e: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

263.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
263.t: simareh se jan jin kau prabh miaa ||
263.e: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||
Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.
Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
263.t: har simaran bhe sidh jatee dhaate ||
263.e: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
263.t: har simaran neech chahu ku(n)T jaate ||
263.e: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.
For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.
Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.
In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.
By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

263.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
263.t: naanak gurmukh har simaran tin paiaa ||8||1||
263.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||
Shalok:

263.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
263.t: dheen dharadh dhukh bha(n)janaa ghaT ghaT naath anaath ||
263.e: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

263.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
263.t: saran tum(h)aaree aaio naanak ke prabh saath ||1||
263.e: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||

264.g: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
264.t: asaTapadhee ||
264.e: Ashtapadee:

264.g: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
264.t: jeh maat pitaa sut meet na bhaiee ||
264.e: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings

264.g: ਮਨ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
264.t: man uoohaa naam terai sa(n)g sahaiee ||
264.e: O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.

264.g: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
264.t: jeh mahaa bhiaan dhoot jam dhalai ||
264.e: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,

264.g: ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
264.t: teh keval naam sa(n)g terai chalai ||
264.e: there, only the Naam shall go along with you.

264.g: ਜਹ ਮੁਸਕਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
264.t: jeh musakal hovai at bhaaree ||
264.e: Where the obstacles are so very heavy,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
264.t: har ko naam khin maeh udhaaree ||
264.e: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਤਰੈ ॥
264.t: anik punahacharan karat nahee tarai ||
264.e: By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
264.t: har ko naam koT paap paraharai ||
264.e: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.

264.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
264.t: gurmukh naam japahu man mere ||
264.e: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
264.t: naanak paavahu sookh ghanere ||1||
264.e: O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||

264.g: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
264.t: sagal sirasaT ko raajaa dhukheeaa ||
264.e: The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam japat hoi sukheeaa ||
264.e: one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.

264.g: ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
264.t: laakh karoree ba(n)dh na parai ||
264.e: Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam japat nisatarai ||
264.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤਿਖ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
264.t: anik maiaa ra(n)g tikh na bujhaavai ||
264.e: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਆਘਾਵੈ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam japat aaghaavai ||
264.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.

264.g: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
264.t: jeh maarag ih jaat ikelaa ||
264.e: Upon that path where you must go all alone,

264.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
264.t: teh har naam sa(n)g hot suhelaa ||
264.e: there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.

264.g: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
264.t: aaisaa naam man sadhaa dhiaaieeaai ||
264.e: On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
264.t: naanak gurmukh param gat paieeaai ||2||
264.e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||

264.g: ਛੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੀ ॥
264.t: chhooTat nahee koT lakh baahee ||
264.e: You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.

264.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
264.t: naam japat teh paar paraahee ||
264.e: Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਘਨ ਜਹ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
264.t: anik bighan jeh aai sa(n)ghaarai ||
264.e: Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam tatakaal udhaarai ||
264.e: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
264.t: anik jon janamai mar jaam ||
264.e: Through countless incarnations, you were born, then died and then born again.

264.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
264.t: naam japat paavai bisraam ||
264.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.

264.g: ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
264.t: hau mailaa mal kabahu na dhovai ||
264.e: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam koT paap khovai ||
264.e: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.

264.g: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
264.t: aaisaa naam japahu man ra(n)g ||
264.e: Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
264.t: naanak paieeaai saadh kai sa(n)g ||3||
264.e: O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||

264.g: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਕੋਸਾ ॥
264.t: jeh maarag ke gane jaeh na kosaa ||
264.e: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਸਾ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam uoohaa sa(n)g tosaa ||
264.e: there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.

264.g: ਜਿਹ ਪੈਡੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
264.t: jeh paiddai mahaa a(n)dh gubaaraa ||
264.e: On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam sa(n)g ujeeaaraa ||
264.e: the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

264.g: ਜਹਾ ਪੰਥਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਨੂ ॥
264.t: jahaa pa(n)th teraa ko na sin(j)aanoo ||
264.e: On that journey where no one knows you,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam teh naal pachhaanoo ||
264.e: with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

264.g: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ ॥
264.t: jeh mahaa bhiaan tapat bahu ghaam ||
264.e: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,

264.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਾਮ ॥
264.t: teh har ke naam kee tum uoopar chhaam ||
264.e: there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.

264.g: ਜਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਮਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਆਕਰਖੈ ॥
264.t: jahaa tirakhaa man tujh aakarakhai ||
264.e: Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,

264.g: ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
264.t: teh naanak har har a(n)mrit barakhai ||4||
264.e: there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||

264.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
264.t: bhagat janaa kee baratan naam ||
264.e: Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.

264.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
264.t: sa(n)t janaa kai man bisraam ||
264.e: The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam dhaas kee oT ||
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
264.t: har kai naam udhare jan koT ||
264.e: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
264.t: har jas karat sa(n)t dhin raat ||
264.e: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਾਧ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
264.t: har har aaukhadh saadh kamaat ||
264.e: Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
264.t: har jan kai har naam nidhaan ||
264.e: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.

264.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨ ॥
264.t: paarabraham jan keeno dhaan ||
264.e: The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.

264.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
264.t: man tan ra(n)g rate ra(n)g ekai ||
264.e: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥੫॥
264.t: naanak jan kai birat bibekai ||5||
264.e: O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam jan kau mukat jugat ||
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
264.t: har kai naam jan kau tirapat bhugat ||
264.e: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam jan kaa roop ra(n)g ||
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਬ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
264.t: har naam japat kab parai na bha(n)g ||
264.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
264.t: har kaa naam jan kee vaddiaaiee ||
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
264.t: har kai naam jan sobhaa paiee ||
264.e: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
265.t: har kaa naam jan kau bhog jog ||
265.e: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
265.t: har naam japat kachh naeh biog ||
265.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

265.g: ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
265.t: jan raataa har naam kee sevaa ||
265.e: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
265.t: har har jan kai maal khajeenaa ||
265.e: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
265.t: har dhan jan kau aap prabh dheenaa ||
265.e: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
265.t: har har jan kai oT sataanee ||
265.e: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਜਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
265.t: har prataap jan avar na jaanee ||
265.e: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

265.g: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
265.t: ot pot jan har ras raate ||
265.e: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.
In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

265.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ॥
265.t: aaTh pahar jan har har japai ||
265.e: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
265.t: har kaa bhagat pragaT nahee chhapai ||
265.e: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
265.t: har kee bhagat mukat bahu kare ||
265.e: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.
O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||
This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.
The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

265.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
265.t: sabh te uootam har kee kathaa ||
265.e: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.
Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

265.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦ ਵਸੈ ॥
265.t: naam kee mahimaa sa(n)t ridh vasai ||
265.e: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.
By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.
The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.
Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

265.g: ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
265.t: naam tul kachh avar na hoi ||
265.e: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
265.t: naanak gurmukh naam paavai jan koi ||8||2||
265.e: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2||
Shalok:

265.g: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਪੇਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਢਢੋਲਿ ॥
265.t: bahu saasatr bahu simritee pekhe sarab ddaddol ||
265.e: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched through them all.

265.g: ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ ॥੧॥
265.t: poojas naahee har hare naanak naam amol ||1||
265.e: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;
the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;
the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;
the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;
the performance of all sorts of works;
donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;
cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;
keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts
- none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
265.t: naanak gurmukh naam japeeaai ik baar ||1||
265.e: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

265.g: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
265.t: nau kha(n)dd pirathamee firai chir jeevai ||
265.e: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;
you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation
and burn yourself in fire;
you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;
you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;
you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;
piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

265.g: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
265.t: tau bhee haumai mail na jaavai ||
265.e: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
265.t: har ke naam samasar kachh naeh ||
265.e: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
265.t: naanak gurmukh naam japat gat paeh ||2||
265.e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||
With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

265.g: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
265.t: garab gumaan na man te huTai ||
265.e: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.
You may practice cleansing day and night,

265.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
265.t: man kee mail na tan te jaat ||
265.e: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

265.g: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
265.t: eis dhehee kau bahu saadhanaa karai ||
265.e: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

265.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਟਰੈ ॥
265.t: man te kabahoo na bikhiaa Tarai ||
265.e: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.
You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,
but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

265.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਊਚ ॥
265.t: man har ke naam kee mahimaa uooch ||
265.e: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
265.t: naanak naam udhare patit bahu mooch ||3||
265.e: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

265.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
265.t: bahut siaanap jam kaa bhau biaapai ||
265.e: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

266.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
266.t: anik jatan kar tirasan naa dhraapai ||
266.e: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.
Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.
Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.
You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,
if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.
All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

266.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
266.t: govi(n)dh bhajan bin til nahee maanai ||
266.e: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
266.t: har kaa naam japat dhukh jai ||
266.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.
O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||
One who prays for the four cardinal blessings
should commit himself to the service of the Saints.
If you wish to erase your sorrows,

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
266.t: har har naam ridhai sadh gaavai ||
266.e: sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.
If you long for honor for yourself,
then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

266.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
266.t: je ko janam maran te ddarai ||
266.e: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,
then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

266.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
266.t: jis jan kau prabh dharas piaasaa ||
266.e: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan

266.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
266.t: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa ||5||
266.e: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||
Among all persons, the supreme person is the one
who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.
One who sees himself as lowly,
shall be accounted as the highest of all.

266.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
266.t: jaa kaa man hoi sagal kee reenaa ||
266.e: One whose mind is the dust of all,

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
266.t: har har naam tin ghaT ghaT cheenaa ||
266.e: recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.
One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,
looks upon all the world as his friend.
One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,
O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||
To the poor, Your Name is wealth.
To the homeless, Your Name is home.
To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.
To all, You are the Giver of gifts.
O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,
Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:
You alone know Your own condition and state.
You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.
You alone can celebrate Your Praises.
O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||
Of all religions, the best religion

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
266.t: har ko naam jap niramal karam ||
266.e: is to chant the Name of the Lord and maintain pure conduct.
Of all religious rituals, the most sublime ritual
is to erase the filth of the dirty mind in the Company of the Holy.
Of all efforts, the best effort

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਸਦਾ ॥
266.t: har kaa naam japahu jeea sadhaa ||
266.e: is to chant the Name of the Lord in the heart, forever.
Of all speech, the most ambrosial speech

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
266.t: har ko jas sun rasan bakhaanee ||
266.e: is to hear the Lord's Praise and chant it with the tongue.

266.g: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
266.t: sagal thaan te oh uootam thaan ||
266.e: Of all places, the most sublime place,

266.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
266.t: naanak jeh ghaT vasai har naam ||8||3||
266.e: O Nanak, is that heart in which the Name of the Lord abides. ||8||3||
Shalok:

266.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਇਆਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
266.t: niraguneeaar iaaniaa so prabh sadhaa samaal ||
266.e: You worthless, ignorant fool - dwell upon God forever.

266.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
266.t: jin keeaa tis cheet rakh naanak nibahee naal ||1||
266.e: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;
what is your origin, and what is your appearance?
He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you
in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.
In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.
In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.

266.g: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਕ ਸੈਨ ॥ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਬੈਠ ਕਉ ਦੈਨ ॥
266.t: biradh bhiaa uoopar saak sain || mukh apiaau baiTh kau dhain ||
266.e: As you grow old, family and friends are there to feed you as you rest.

267.g: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
267.t: eih niragun gun kachhoo na boojhai ||
267.e: This worthless person has not appreciated in the least, all the good deeds done for him.
If you bless him with forgiveness, O Nanak, only then will he be saved. ||1||

267.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
267.t: jeh prasaadh dhar uoopar sukh baseh ||
267.e: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.

267.g: ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ॥
267.t: sut bhraat meet banitaa sa(n)g haseh ||
267.e: With your children, siblings, friends and spouse, you laugh.
By His Grace, you drink in cool water.
You have peaceful breezes and priceless fire.
By His Grace, you enjoy all sorts of pleasures.
You are provided with all the necessities of life.

267.g: ਦੀਨੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
267.t: dheene hasat paav karan netr rasanaa ||
267.e: He gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue,
and yet, you forsake Him and attach yourself to others.
Such sinful mistakes cling to the blind fools;
Nanak: uplift and save them, God! ||2||
From beginning to end, He is our Protector,

267.g: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
267.t: tis siau preet na karai gavaar ||
267.e: and yet, the ignorant do not give their love to Him.

267.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
267.t: jaa kee sevaa nav nidh paavai ||
267.e: Serving Him, the nine treasures are obtained,

267.g: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
267.t: taa siau mooRaa man nahee laavai ||
267.e: and yet, the foolish do not link their minds with Him.
Our Lord and Master is Ever-present, forever and ever,
and yet, the spiritually blind believe that He is far away.

267.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
267.t: jaa kee Tahal paavai dharageh maan ||
267.e: In His service, one obtains honor in the Court of the Lord,
and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.
Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;
O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||
Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.
They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.

267.g: ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ ਸੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
267.t: jo chhaddanaa su asathir kar maanai ||
267.e: That which passes away, they believe to be permanent.
That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

267.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
267.t: chhodd jai tis kaa sram karai ||
267.e: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.
They turn away from the Lord, their Help and Support, who is always with them.
They wash off the sandalwood paste;
like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.
They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.
Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||
They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.
They curse others day and night.
Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.
They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.
Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,
but within clings the dog of greed.
The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.
There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?

267.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
267.t: jaa kai a(n)tar basai prabh aap ||
267.e: Those, within whom God Himself abides
- O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
By listening, how can the blind find the path?
Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.
How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?
Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.
How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?

267.g: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
267.t: jatan karai tau bhee sur bha(n)g ||
267.e: He may try, but his voice will fail him.
How can the cripple climb up the mountain?
He simply cannot go there.

267.g: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
267.t: karataar karunaa mai dheen benatee karai ||
267.e: O Creator, Lord of Mercy - Your humble servant prays;
Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||

267.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
267.t: sa(n)g sahaiee su aavai na cheet ||
267.e: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.
He shows love to his enemies.
He lives in a castle of sand.
He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.
He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.
Death does not even come to mind for the fool.
Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,
falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:

268.e: So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

268.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੭॥
268.t: naanak raakh leh aapan kar karam ||7||
268.e: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||
You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.
This body and soul are all Your property.

268.g: ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
268.t: tum maat pitaa ham baarik tere ||
268.e: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.
In Your Grace, there are so many joys!
No one knows Your limits.
O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,
the whole creation is strung on Your thread.
That which has come from You is under Your Command.

268.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
268.t: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee ||
268.e: You alone know Your state and extent.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4||
Shalok:

268.g: ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
268.t: dhenahaar prabh chhodd kai laageh aan suaai ||
268.e: One who renounces God the Giver, and attaches himself to other affairs

268.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
268.t: naanak kahoo na seejhiee bin naavai pat jai ||1||
268.e: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;
for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

268.g: ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਦਸ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
268.t: ek bhee na dhei dhas bhee hir lei ||
268.e: But what if that one thing were not given, and the ten were taken away?
Then, what could the fool say or do?
Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.
Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.

268.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
268.t: jaa kai man laagaa prabh meeThaa ||
268.e: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet
all pleasures come to abide in his mind.
One who abides by the Lord's Will,
O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||
God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,
who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

268.g: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਮਾਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
268.t: apunee amaan kachh bahur saahu lei ||
268.e: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,
the ignorant person shows his anger.
He himself destroys his own credibility,

268.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
268.t: bahur us kaa bisavaiaas na hovai ||
268.e: and he shall not again be trusted.

268.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
268.t: jis kee basat tis aagai raakhai ||
268.e: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,
and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,
the Lord will make him happy four times over.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||

268.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥ ਸਰਪਰ ਹੋਵਤ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨੇਤ ॥
268.t: anik bhaat maiaa ke het || sarapar hovat jaan anet ||
268.e: The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away - know that they are transitory.

268.g: ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
268.t: birakh kee chhaiaa siau ra(n)g laavai ||
268.e: People fall in love with the shade of the tree,
and when it passes away, they feel regret in their minds.
Whatever is seen, shall pass away;
and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.
One who gives her love to a passing traveler

268.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੇਹ ॥
268.t: taa kau haath na aavai keh ||
268.e: nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

268.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
268.t: man har ke naam kee preet sukhadhaiee ||
268.e: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.

268.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
268.t: kar kirapaa naanak aap le laiee ||3||
268.e: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||
False are body, wealth, and all relations.
False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.
False are power, youth, wealth and property.
False are sexual desire and wild anger.
False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.

268.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਸਤਾ ॥
268.t: mithiaa ra(n)g sa(n)g maiaa pekh hasataa ||
268.e: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.
False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.
False are pride and self-conceit.
Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.

268.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥
268.t: naanak jap jap jeevai har ke charan ||4||
268.e: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||
False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.

268.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਸਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
268.t: mithiaa hasat par dharab kau hireh ||
268.e: False are the hands which steal the wealth of others.

269.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪਾਦ ॥
269.t: mithiaa netr pekhat par tria roopaadh ||
269.e: False are the eyes which gaze upon the beauty of another's wife.
False is the tongue which enjoys delicacies and external tastes.

269.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਪਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
269.t: mithiaa charan par bikaar kau dhaaveh ||
269.e: False are the feet which run to do evil to others.
False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.
False is the body which does not do good to others.
False is the nose which inhales corruption.
Without understanding, everything is false.

269.g: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
269.t: safal dheh naanak har har naam le ||5||
269.e: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||
The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?
Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.
From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.

269.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
269.t: bin simaran dhin rain birathaa bihai ||
269.e: Without the remembrance of the Lord, day and night pass in vain,
like the crop which withers without rain.

269.g: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
269.t: gobidh bhajan bin birathe sabh kaam ||
269.e: Without meditation on the Lord of the Universe, all works are in vain,
like the wealth of a miser, which lies useless.

269.g: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
269.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n te jan jeh ghaT basio har naau ||
269.e: Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

269.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
269.t: naanak taa kai bal bal jaau ||6||
269.e: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||6||
He says one thing, and does something else.

269.g: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ ॥
269.t: man nahee preet mukhahu ga(n)dd laavat ||
269.e: There is no love in his heart, and yet with his mouth he talks tall.
The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.
He is not impressed by outward display.
One who does not practice what he preaches to others,
shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.
One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord
by his teachings, the world is saved.

269.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
269.t: jo tum bhaane tin prabh jaataa ||
269.e: Those who are pleasing to You, God, know You.
Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||
Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.
He Himself values His own creatures.
He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.

269.g: ਕਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਨਾਵਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਵਤ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
269.t: kisai dhoor janaavat kisai bujhaavat neraa ||
269.e: To some, He appears far away, while others perceive Him near at hand.
He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.

269.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
269.t: sabh kachh jaanai aatam kee rahat ||
269.e: He knows all the ways and means of the soul.

269.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
269.t: jis bhaavai tis le laR lai ||
269.e: Those with whom He is pleased are attached to the hem of His robe.
He is pervading all places and interspaces.
Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.
Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5||
Shalok:

269.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
269.t: kaam karodh ar lobh moh binas jai aha(n)mev ||
269.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - may these be gone, and egotism as well.

269.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
269.t: naanak prabh saranaagatee kar prasaadh gurdhev ||1||
269.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; please bless me with Your Grace, O Divine Guru. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;

269.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
269.t: tis Thaakur kau rakh man maeh ||
269.e: enshrine that Lord and Master within your mind.
By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;

269.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
269.t: tis kau simarat param gat paaveh ||
269.e: remembering Him, the supreme status is obtained.
By His Grace, you dwell in the palace of peace;
meditate forever on Him within your mind.

269.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
269.t: jeh prasaadh gireh sa(n)g sukh basanaa ||
269.e: By His Grace, you abide with your family in peace;
keep His remembrance upon your tongue, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;
O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||
By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;
why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?
By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;

269.g: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੀਜੈ ॥
269.t: man aaTh pahar taa kaa jas gaaveejai ||
269.e: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

269.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
269.t: jeh prasaadh tujh sabh kouoo maanai ||
269.e: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone;

270.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
270.t: mukh taa ko jas rasan bakhaanai ||
270.e: with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.
By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;
O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.

270.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
270.t: prabh jee japat dharageh maan paaveh ||
270.e: Meditating on God, you shall be honored in His Court;
O Nanak, you shall return to your true home with honor. ||2||
By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;
attune yourself to that Loving Lord.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

270.g: ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
270.t: man sukh paaveh har har jas kahat ||
270.e: O mind, chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, and find peace.

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਢਾਕੇ ॥
270.t: jeh prasaadh tere sagal chhidhr ddaake ||
270.e: By His Grace, all your deficits are covered;

270.g: ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
270.t: man saranee par Thaakur prabh taa kai ||
270.e: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
270.t: jeh prasaadh tujh ko na pahoochai ||
270.e: By His Grace, no one can rival you;

270.g: ਮਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚੇ ॥
270.t: man saas saas simarahu prabh uooche ||
270.e: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.
By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;
O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||
By His Grace, you wear decorations;

270.g: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
270.t: man tis simarat kiau aalas keejai ||
270.e: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?
By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;

270.g: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
270.t: man tis prabh kau kabahoo na bisaaree ||
270.e: O mind, never forget that God.
By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;
keep God enshrined in your heart.
O mind, the One who formed your form
standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.
Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;
here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
270.t: jeh prasaadh kareh pu(n)n bahu dhaan ||
270.e: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;

270.g: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
270.t: man aaTh pahar kar tis kaa dhiaan ||
270.e: O mind, meditate on Him, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;

270.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
270.t: tis prabh kau saas saas chitaaree ||
270.e: think of God with each and every breath.
By His Grace, your form is so beautiful;
constantly remember God, the Incomparably Beautiful One.
By His Grace, you have such high social status;

270.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
270.t: so prabh simar sadhaa dhin raat ||
270.e: remember God always, day and night.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||
By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.
By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.
By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.
By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.
By His Grace, your hands move and work.
By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.
By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.
By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.

270.g: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਲਾਗਹੁ ॥
270.t: aaisaa prabh tiaag avar kat laagahu ||
270.e: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||
By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;

270.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
270.t: tis prabh kau mool na manahu bisaar ||
270.e: never forget God from your mind.
By His Grace, you have prestige;

270.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
270.t: re man mooR too taa kau jaap ||
270.e: O foolish mind, meditate on Him!
By His Grace, your works are completed;
O mind, know Him to be close at hand.
By His Grace, you find the Truth;

270.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
270.t: re man mere too(n) taa siau raach ||
270.e: O my mind, merge yourself into Him.

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
270.t: jeh prasaadh sabh kee gat hoi ||
270.e: By His Grace, everyone is saved;
O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||
Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.

270.g: ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
270.t: aap gaavaae su har gun gaau ||
270.e: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

271.e: By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.
By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.

271.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
271.t: prabh dhiaa te mat uootam hoi ||
271.e: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.
All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.
No one obtains anything by himself.

271.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
271.t: jit jit laavahu tit lageh har naath ||
271.e: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.

271.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
271.t: naanak in kai kachhoo na haath ||8||6||
271.e: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6||
Shalok:
Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;

271.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
271.t: jo jo kahai su mukataa hoi ||
271.e: whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.

271.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੰਤਾ ॥ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ॥੧॥
271.t: sun meetaa naanak binava(n)taa || saadh janaa kee acharaj kathaa ||1||
271.e: Listen, O friends, Nanak prays, to the wonderful story of the Holy. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g mukh uoojal hot ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.
In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.
In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.
In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g bujhai prabh neraa ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.
In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam ratan ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g ek uoopar jatan ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
271.t: saadh kee mahimaa baranai kaun praanee ||
271.e: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?

271.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
271.t: naanak saadh kee sobhaa prabh maeh samaanee ||1||
271.e: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||
In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g aaveh bas pa(n)chaa ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.
In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.
In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.
In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g na katahoo(n) dhaavai ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.
In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g maiaa te bhi(n)n ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.
In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||
In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.
In the Company of the Holy, there is great purity.
In the Company of the Holy, no one is hated.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g na beegaa pair ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's feet do not wander.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee ko ma(n)dhaa ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, no one seems evil.
In the Company of the Holy, supreme bliss is known.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee hau taap ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the fever of ego departs.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g tajai sabh aap ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one renounces all selfishness.
He Himself knows the greatness of the Holy.
O Nanak, the Holy are at one with God. ||3||

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g na kabahoo dhaavai ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g sadhaa sukh paavai ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains everlasting peace.
In the Company of the Holy, one grasps the Incomprehensible.
In the Company of the Holy, one can endure the unendurable.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਊਚੈ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g basai thaan uoochai ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one abides in the loftiest place.
In the Company of the Holy, one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g dhiraRai sabh dharam ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's Dharmic faith is firmly established.
In the Company of the Holy, one dwells with the Supreme Lord God.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam nidhaan ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the treasure of the Naam.
O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Holy. ||4||

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g sabh kul udhaarai ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.
In the Company of the Holy, one's friends, acquaintances and relatives are redeemed.

271.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
271.t: saadhoo kai sa(n)g so dhan paavai ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, that wealth is obtained.

271.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ॥
271.t: jis dhan te sabh ko varasaavai ||
271.e: Everyone benefits from that wealth.
In the Company of the Holy, the Lord of Dharma serves.
In the Company of the Holy, the divine, angelic beings sing God's Praises.
In the Company of the Holy, one's sins fly away.
In the Company of the Holy, one sings the Ambrosial Glories.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਗੰਮਿ ॥
271.t: saadh kai sa(n)g srab thaan ga(n)m ||
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, all places are within reach.

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮ ॥੫॥
272.t: naanak saadh kai sa(n)g safal jana(n)m ||5||
272.e: O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, one's life becomes fruitful. ||5||

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
272.t: saadh kai sa(n)g nahee kachh ghaal ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.
The Blessed Vision of their Darshan brings a sublime, happy peace.
In the Company of the Holy, blemishes are removed.
In the Company of the Holy, hell is far away.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
272.t: saadh kai sa(n)g ieehaa uoohaa suhelaa ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, one is happy here and hereafter.
In the Company of the Holy, the separated ones are reunited with the Lord.
The fruits of one's desires are obtained.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
272.t: saadh kai sa(n)g na birathaa jaavai ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, no one goes empty-handed.
The Supreme Lord God dwells in the hearts of the Holy.
O Nanak, listening to the sweet words of the Holy, one is saved. ||6||

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
272.t: saadh kai sa(n)g sunau har naau ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
272.t: saadh kai sa(n)g na man te bisarai ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, do not forget Him from your mind.
In the Company of the Holy, you shall surely be saved.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
272.t: saadh kai sa(n)g lagai prabh meeThaa ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, God seems very sweet.

272.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
272.t: saadhoo kai sa(n)g ghaT ghaT ddeeThaa ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, He is seen in each and every heart.
In the Company of the Holy, we become obedient to the Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, we obtain the state of salvation.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
272.t: saadh kai sa(n)g miTe sabh rog ||
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, all diseases are cured.
O Nanak, one meets with the Holy, by highest destiny. ||7||

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
272.t: saadh kee mahimaa bedh na jaaneh ||
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.
They can describe only what they have heard.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
272.t: saadh kee upamaa tih gun te dhoor ||
272.e: The greatness of the Holy people is beyond the three qualities.
The greatness of the Holy people is all-pervading.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ॥
272.t: saadh kee sobhaa kaa naahee a(n)t ||
272.e: The glory of the Holy people has no limit.
The glory of the Holy people is infinite and eternal.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ ॥
272.t: saadh kee sobhaa uooch te uoochee ||
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is the highest of the high.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
272.t: saadh kee sobhaa mooch te moochee ||
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is the greatest of the great.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
272.t: saadh kee sobhaa saadh ban aaiee ||
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is theirs alone;

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥
272.t: naanak saadh prabh bhedh na bhaiee ||8||7||
272.e: O Nanak, there is no difference between the Holy people and God. ||8||7||
Shalok:
The True One is on his mind, and the True One is upon his lips.

272.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
272.t: avar na pekhai ekas bin koi ||
272.e: He sees only the One.

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਲਛਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
272.t: naanak ieh lachhan braham giaanee hoi ||1||
272.e: O Nanak, these are the qualities of the God-conscious being. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The God-conscious being is always unattached,
as the lotus in the water remains detached.
The God-conscious being is always unstained,
like the sun, which gives its comfort and warmth to all.
The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,

272.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
272.t: jaise raaj ra(n)k kau laagai tul pavaan ||
272.e: like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.
The God-conscious being has a steady patience,

272.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ॥
272.t: jiau basudhaa kouoo khodhai kouoo cha(n)dhan lep ||
272.e: like the earth, which is dug up by one, and anointed with sandal paste by another.
This is the quality of the God-conscious being:

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
272.t: naanak jiau paavak kaa sahaj subhaau ||1||
272.e: O Nanak, his inherent nature is like a warming fire. ||1||
The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;
filth does not stick to water.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
272.t: braham giaanee kai man hoi pragaas ||
272.e: The God-conscious being's mind is enlightened,
like the sky above the earth.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
272.t: braham giaanee kai mitr satr samaan ||
272.e: To the God-conscious being, friend and foe are the same.
The God-conscious being has no egotistical pride.
The God-conscious being is the highest of the high.

272.g: ਮਨਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
272.t: man apanai hai sabh te neechaa ||
272.e: Within his own mind, he is the most humble of all.
They alone become God-conscious beings,
O Nanak, whom God Himself makes so. ||2||
The God-conscious being is the dust of all.
The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
272.t: braham giaanee kee sabh uoopar miaa ||
272.e: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
272.t: braham giaanee te kachh buraa na bhiaa ||
272.e: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is always impartial.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kee dhirasaT a(n)mrit barasee ||
273.e: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.
The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.
Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
273.t: naanak braham giaanee kaa braham dhiaan ||3||
273.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||
The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.
The God-conscious being shall never perish.
The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.
The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.
The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.
The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kai hoi su bhalaa ||
273.e: The God-conscious being acts in the common good.
The God-conscious being blossoms in fruitfulness.
In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
273.t: naanak braham giaanee japai sagal sa(n)saar ||4||
273.e: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||
The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kai basai prabh sa(n)g ||
273.e: The God-conscious being dwells with God.
The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.
The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.
The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.
The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.
In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kai ghar sadhaa ana(n)dh ||
273.e: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.
The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
273.t: naanak braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas ||5||
273.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||
The God-conscious being knows God.
The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.
The God-conscious being is carefree.
Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee jis karai prabh aap ||
273.e: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.
The God-conscious being is gloriously great.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kaa dharas baddabhaagee paieeaai ||
273.e: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by great good fortune.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kau bal bal jaieeaai ||
273.e: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.
The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.
O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||
The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kai sagal man maeh ||
273.e: The God-conscious being has all within his mind.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਉਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kaa kaun jaanai bhedh ||
273.e: Who can know the mystery of the God-conscious being?
Forever bow to the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਥਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kaa kathiaa na jai adhaakhayer ||
273.e: The God-conscious being cannot be described in words.
The God-conscious being is the Lord and Master of all.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kee mit kaun bakhaanai ||
273.e: Who can describe the limits of the God-conscious being?

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kee gat braham giaanee jaanai ||
273.e: Only the God-conscious being can know the state of the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kaa a(n)t na paar ||
273.e: The God-conscious being has no end or limitation.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
273.t: naanak braham giaanee kau sadhaa namasakaar ||7||
273.e: O Nanak, to the God-conscious being, bow forever in reverence. ||7||

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee sabh sirasaT kaa karataa ||
273.e: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee sadh jeevai nahee marataa ||
273.e: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee mukat jugat jeea kaa dhaataa ||
273.e: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.
The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.
The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
273.t: braham giaanee kaa sabh uoopar haath ||
273.e: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.
The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.

274.e: The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

274.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
274.t: braham giaanee kee sobhaa braham giaanee banee ||
274.e: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
274.t: naanak braham giaanee sarab kaa dhanee ||8||8||
274.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||
Shalok:
One who enshrines the Naam within the heart,
who sees the Lord God in all,
who, each and every moment, bows in reverence to the Lord Master
- O Nanak, such a one is the true 'touch-nothing Saint', who emancipates everyone. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
One whose tongue does not touch falsehood;
whose mind is filled with love for the Blessed Vision of the Pure Lord,

274.g: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ॥
274.t: par tria roop na pekhai netr ||
274.e: whose eyes do not gaze upon the beauty of others' wives,
who serves the Holy and loves the Saints' Congregation,

274.g: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
274.t: karan na sunai kaahoo kee ni(n)dhaa ||
274.e: whose ears do not listen to slander against anyone,

274.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
274.t: sabh te jaanai aapas kau ma(n)dhaa ||
274.e: who deems himself to be the worst of all,
who, by Guru's Grace, renounces corruption,

274.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
274.t: man kee baasanaa man te Tarai ||
274.e: who banishes the mind's evil desires from his mind,

274.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਜਿਤ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
274.t: ei(n)dhree jit pa(n)ch dhokh te rahat ||
274.e: who conquers his sexual instincts and is free of the five sinful passions

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਅਪਰਸ ॥੧॥
274.t: naanak koT madhe ko aaisaa aparas ||1||
274.e: - O Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely one such 'touch-nothing Saint'. ||1||
The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughly pleased.

274.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
274.t: bisan kee maiaa te hoi bhi(n)n ||
274.e: He dwells apart from Maya.
Performing good deeds, he does not seek rewards.
Spotlessly pure is the religion of such a Vaishnaav;

274.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
274.t: kaahoo fal kee ichhaa nahee baachhai ||
274.e: he has no desire for the fruits of his labors.
He is absorbed in devotional worship and the singing of Kirtan, the songs of the Lord's Glory.
Within his mind and body, he meditates in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
He is kind to all creatures.
He holds fast to the Naam, and inspires others to chant it.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
274.t: naanak oh baisano param gat paavai ||2||
274.e: O Nanak, such a Vaishnaav obtains the supreme status. ||2||
The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.
He forsakes the company of all wicked people.
All doubts are removed from his mind.
He performs devotional service to the Supreme Lord God in all.
In the Company of the Holy, the filth of sin is washed away.

274.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
274.t: tis bhagautee kee mat uootam hovai ||
274.e: The wisdom of such a Bhagaautee becomes supreme.

274.g: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
274.t: bhagava(n)t kee Tahal karai nit neet ||
274.e: He constantly performs the service of the Supreme Lord God.
He dedicates his mind and body to the Love of God.
The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide in his heart.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
274.t: naanak aaisaa bhagautee bhagava(n)t kau paavai ||3||
274.e: O Nanak, such a Bhagaautee attains the Lord God. ||3||
He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.
He searches for the Lord's Name within his own soul.
He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.

274.g: ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
274.t: aus pa(n)ddit kai upadhes jag jeevai ||
274.e: By that Pandit's teachings, the world lives.
He implants the Sermon of the Lord in his heart.

274.g: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
274.t: so pa(n)ddit fir jon na aavai ||
274.e: Such a Pandit is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again.
He understands the fundamental essence of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the unmanifest, he sees the manifest world to exist.
He gives instruction to people of all castes and social classes.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੪॥
274.t: naanak us pa(n)ddit kau sadhaa adhes ||4||
274.e: O Nanak, to such a Pandit, I bow in salutation forever. ||4||
The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.

274.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
274.t: chahu varanaa meh japai kouoo naam ||
274.e: Anyone, from any class, may chant the Naam.

274.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
274.t: jo jo japai tis kee gat hoi ||
274.e: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.
And yet, rare are those who attain it, in the Company of the Holy.
By His Grace, He enshrines it within.

274.g: ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਮੁਘਦ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
274.t: pas pret mughadh paathar kau taarai ||
274.e: Even beasts, ghosts and the stone-hearted are saved.
The Naam is the panacea, the remedy to cure all ills.
Singing the Glory of God is the embodiment of bliss and emancipation.

274.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਧਰਮਿ ॥
274.t: kaahoo jugat kitai na paieeaai dharam ||
274.e: It cannot be obtained by any religious rituals.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ॥੫॥
274.t: naanak tis milai jis likhiaa dhur karam ||5||
274.e: O Nanak, he alone obtains it, whose karma is so pre-ordained. ||5||

274.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
274.t: jis kai man paarabraham kaa nivaas ||
274.e: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God

275.e: - his name is truly Ram Das, the Lord's servant.
He comes to have the Vision of the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
Deeming himself to be the slave of the Lord's slaves, he obtains it.
He knows the Lord to be Ever-present, close at hand.
Such a servant is honored in the Court of the Lord.

275.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
275.t: apune dhaas kau aap kirapaa karai ||
275.e: To His servant, He Himself shows His Mercy.

275.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
275.t: tis dhaas kau sabh sojhee parai ||
275.e: Such a servant understands everything.
Amidst all, his soul is unattached.
Such is the way, O Nanak, of the Lord's servant. ||6||
One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,
is said to be Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
As is joy, so is sorrow to him.
He is in eternal bliss, and is not separated from God.
As is gold, so is dust to him.
As is ambrosial nectar, so is bitter poison to him.
As is honor, so is dishonor.
As is the beggar, so is the king.
Whatever God ordains, that is his way.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੭॥
275.t: naanak oh purakh kaheeaai jeevan mukat ||7||
275.e: O Nanak, that being is known as Jivan Mukta. ||7||
All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.

275.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
275.t: jit jit ghar raakhai taisaa tin naau ||
275.e: According to the homes in which they are placed, so are His creatures named.
He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
Whatever pleases God, ultimately comes to pass.
He Himself is All-pervading, in endless waves.

275.g: ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
275.t: lakhe na jaeh paarabraham ke ra(n)g ||
275.e: The playful sport of the Supreme Lord God cannot be known.
As the understanding is given, so is one enlightened.
The Supreme Lord God, the Creator, is eternal and everlasting.
Forever, forever and ever, He is merciful.
Remembering Him, remembering Him in meditation, O Nanak, one is blessed with ecstasy. ||8||9||
Shalok:

275.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
275.t: ausatat kareh anek jan a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
275.e: Many people praise the Lord. He has no end or limitation.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਚੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
275.t: naanak rachanaa prabh rachee bahu bidh anik prakaar ||1||
275.e: O Nanak, God created the creation, with its many ways and various species. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Many millions are His devotees.
Many millions perform religious rituals and worldly duties.
Many millions become dwellers at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Many millions wander as renunciates in the wilderness.
Many millions listen to the Vedas.
Many millions become austere penitents.
Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.
Many millions of poets contemplate Him through poetry.
Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
275.t: naanak karate kaa a(n)t na paaveh ||1||
275.e: O Nanak, none can find the limits of the Creator. ||1||
Many millions become self-centered.
Many millions are blinded by ignorance.
Many millions are stone-hearted misers.
Many millions are heartless, with dry, withered souls.

275.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
275.t: kiee koT par dharab kau hireh ||
275.e: Many millions steal the wealth of others.
Many millions slander others.
Many millions struggle in Maya.
Many millions wander in foreign lands.

275.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
275.t: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
275.e: Whatever God attaches them to - with that they are engaged.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੨॥
275.t: naanak karate kee jaanai karataa rachanaa ||2||
275.e: O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the workings of His creation. ||2||
Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.
Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.
Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.
Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.
Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.
Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.
Many millions are the moons, suns and stars.

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
276.t: kiee koT dhev dhaanav i(n)dhr sir chhatr ||
276.e: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.
He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
276.t: naanak jis jis bhaavai tis tis nisataarai ||3||
276.e: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||
Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
276.t: kiee koT bedh puraan simirat ar saasat ||
276.e: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.
Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.
Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.
Many millions are made long-lived.

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰੀ ਮੇਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
276.t: kiee koT giree mer suvaran theeve ||
276.e: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.
Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - the gods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ ॥
276.t: kiee koT bhoot pret sookar miragaach ||
276.e: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.

276.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
276.t: sabh te nerai sabhahoo te dhoor ||
276.e: He is near to all, and yet far from all;
O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||
Many millions inhabit the nether regions.
Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.
Many millions are born, live and die.
Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.
Many millions eat while sitting at ease.
Many millions are exhausted by their labors.
Many millions are created wealthy.
Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.

276.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
276.t: jeh jeh bhaanaa teh teh raakhe ||
276.e: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੫॥
276.t: naanak sabh kichh prabh kai haathe ||5||
276.e: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||
Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.

276.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
276.t: raam naam sa(n)g tin liv laagee ||
276.e: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.
Many millions are searching for God.
Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.
Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.
They meet with God, the Eternal.
Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.
They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
Those with whom He Himself is pleased,

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
276.t: naanak te jan sadhaa dhan dha(n)n ||6||
276.e: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||
Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.
Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.
Many millions are the divine incarnations.
In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.
So many times, He has expanded His expansion.
Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.
Many millions are created in various forms.

276.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥
276.t: prabh te hoe prabh maeh samaat ||
276.e: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.

276.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
276.t: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koi ||
276.e: His limits are not known to anyone.
Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||
Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.
Their souls are enlightened.
Many millions know the essence of reality.
Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.
Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.

276.g: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
276.t: amar bhe sadh sadh hee jeeveh ||
276.e: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.
Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.
They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.

276.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
276.t: apune jan kau saas saas samaare ||
276.e: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.
O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10||
Shalok:

276.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
276.t: karan kaaran prabh ek hai dhoosar naahee koi ||
276.e: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
276.t: naanak tis balihaaranai jal thal maheeal soi ||1||
276.e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky and all space. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.
That which pleases Him, comes to pass.
In an instant, He creates and destroys.

277.e: He has no end or limitation.
By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.
By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.
By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.
By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.
Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.
O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||
If it pleases God, one attains salvation.
If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.

277.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਸ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
277.t: prabh bhaavai bin saas te raakhai ||
277.e: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.

277.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
277.t: prabh bhaavai taa har gun bhaakhai ||
277.e: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.
If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.
He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
As He wills, He causes actions to be done.
Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||

277.g: ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
277.t: kahu maanukh te kiaa hoi aavai ||
277.e: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?
Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.

277.g: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
277.t: eis kai haath hoi taa sabh kichh lei ||
277.e: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.
Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.
Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.
If they knew better, they would save themselves.
Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.

277.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
277.t: nimakh maeh chaar ku(n)T fir aavai ||
277.e: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.

277.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
277.t: kar kirapaa jis apanee bhagat dhei ||
277.e: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship
- O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||

277.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
277.t: khin meh neech keeT kau raaj ||
277.e: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.
The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.

277.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
277.t: jaa kaa dhirasaT kachhoo na aavai ||
277.e: Even one who has never been seen at all,
becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.
And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings

277.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਨੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
277.t: taa kaa lekhaa na ganai jagadhees ||
277.e: the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

277.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
277.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kee raas ||
277.e: Soul and body are all His property.
Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.
He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.
Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||

277.g: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
277.t: eis kaa bal naahee is haath ||
277.e: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;
the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.
The helpless beings are subject to His Command.

277.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਥੀਉ ॥
277.t: jo tis bhaavai soiee fun theeau ||
277.e: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.
Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.
Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.
Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.
Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions of the underworld.
Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.
O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||
Sometimes, they dance in various ways.
Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.
Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.
Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.
Sometimes, they sit as great kings.
Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.
Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.
Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.

277.g: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ॥
277.t: jiau prabh raakhai tiv hee rahai ||
277.e: As God keeps them, so they remain.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||
Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.
Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.
Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.
Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.

277.g: ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ ॥
277.t: kabahoo keeT hasat pata(n)g hoi jeeaa ||
277.e: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.
They may wander and roam through countless incarnations.

278.e: In various costumes, like actors, they appear.
As it pleases God, they dance.
Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||
Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.

278.g: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
278.t: aus asathaan te bahur na aavai ||
278.e: From that place, he does not have to come back again.
The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.
That place does not perish.

278.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
278.t: man tan naam rate ik ra(n)g ||
278.e: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.

278.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੁ ਆਇ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥
278.t: jiau jal meh jal aai khaTaanaa ||
278.e: As water comes to blend with water,
his light blends into the Light.
Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11||
Shalok:

278.g: ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਮਸਕੀਨੀਆ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਲੇ ॥
278.t: sukhee basai masakeeneeaa aap nivaar tale ||
278.e: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.

278.g: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
278.t: badde badde aha(n)kaareeaa naanak garab gale ||1||
278.e: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
One who has the pride of power within,
shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.
One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,
shall become a maggot in manure.
One who claims to act virtuously,
shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

278.g: ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
278.t: dhan bhoom kaa jo karai gumaan ||
278.e: One who takes pride in wealth and lands
is a fool, blind and ignorant.

278.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
278.t: kar kirapaa jis kai hiradhai gareebee basaavai ||
278.e: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,

278.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
278.t: naanak ieehaa mukat aagai sukh paavai ||1||
278.e: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||
One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

278.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
278.t: tiran samaan kachh sa(n)g na jaavai ||
278.e: not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

278.g: ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਸ ॥
278.t: bahu lasakar maanukh uoopar kare aas ||
278.e: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,

278.g: ਪਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
278.t: pal bheetar taa kaa hoi binaas ||
278.e: but he shall vanish in an instant.
One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,
in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.
One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self
the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.

278.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
278.t: gur prasaadh jaa kaa miTai abhimaan ||
278.e: One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,
O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,
he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.
If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,
he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

278.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਨਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ॥
278.t: anik jatan kar aatam nahee dhravai ||
278.e: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened
how can he go to the Court of the Lord?
One who calls himself good
goodness shall not draw near him.

278.g: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
278.t: sarab kee ren jaa kaa man hoi ||
