278.e: One whose mind is the dust of all

278.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
278.t: kahu naanak taa kee niramal soi ||3||
278.e: - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||

278.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
278.t: jab lag jaanai mujh te kachh hoi ||
278.e: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

278.g: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
278.t: tab is kau sukh naahee koi ||
278.e: he shall have no peace.

278.g: ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
278.t: jab ieh jaanai mai kichh karataa ||
278.e: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,

278.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
278.t: tab lag garabh jon meh firataa ||
278.e: he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.
As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,
his mind shall not come to rest.

278.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
278.t: jab lag moh magan sa(n)g mai ||
278.e: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,

278.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
278.t: tab lag dharam rai dhei sajai ||
278.e: the Righteous Judge shall punish him.
By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||

278.g: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
278.t: sahas khaTe lakh kau uTh dhaavai ||
278.e: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.

279.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
279.t: tirapat na aavai maiaa paachhai paavai ||
279.e: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.
He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,
but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.
Without contentment, no one is satisfied.
Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.
Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.
Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.
He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.
Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.
What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?
As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.
God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.

279.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
279.t: jo kichh keeno su apanai ra(n)g ||
279.e: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.

279.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
279.t: sabh te dhoor sabhahoo kai sa(n)g ||
279.e: He is far from all, and yet with all.
He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

279.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
279.t: marai na binasai aavai na jai ||
279.e: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||
He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.
He Himself mingles with all.
He Himself created His own expanse.

279.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
279.t: sabh kachh us kaa oh karanaihaar ||
279.e: All things are His; He is the Creator.

279.g: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
279.t: aus te bhi(n)n kahahu kichh hoi ||
279.e: Without Him, what could be done?
In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.
In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.
He produces His plays with infinite variety.

279.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
279.t: man meh aap man apune maeh ||
279.e: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.
O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||
True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.
By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.
True, True, True is the Creator of all.
Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.
Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.
You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.
Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,
heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.
Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure
- chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12||
Shalok:

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t saran jo jan parai so jan udharanahaar ||
279.e: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
279.t: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa naanakaa bahur bahur avataar ||1||
279.e: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan jam te nahee chhuTai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sukh sabh jai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan narak meh pai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan mat hoi maleen ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sobhaa te heen ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t ke hate kau rakhai na koi ||
279.e: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan thaan bhrasaT hoi ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.
But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,
O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t ke dhookhan te mukh bhavai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.

279.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਕਾਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਵੈ ॥
279.t: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan kaag jiau lavai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.

279.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
279.t: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan sarap jon pai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਿਰਮਾਇ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan tiragadh jon kiramai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.

279.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੈ ॥
279.t: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan tirasanaa meh jalai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sabh ko chhalai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t kai dhookhan tej sabh jai ||
279.e: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.
Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
279.t: sa(n)t dhokhee kaa thaau ko naeh ||
279.e: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
280.t: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa oi bhee gat paeh ||2||
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਤਤਾਈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak mahaa atataiee ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak khin Tikan na paiee ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮਹਾ ਹਤਿਆਰਾ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak mahaa hatiaaraa ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak paramesur maaraa ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੀਨੁ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak raaj te heen ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨੁ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak dhukheeaa ar dheen ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dhak kau sarab rog ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਜੋਗ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dhak kau sadhaa bijog ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa dhokh meh dhokh ||
280.e: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
280.t: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa us kaa bhee hoi mokh ||3||
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee sadhaa apavit ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee kisai kaa nahee mit ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau ddaan laagai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau sabh tiaagai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee mahaa aha(n)kaaree ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee sadhaa bikaaree ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰੈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee janamai marai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kee dhookhanaa sukh te Tarai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau naahee Thaau ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
280.t: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa le milai ||4||
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee adh beech te TooTai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee kitai kaaj na pahoochai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau udhiaan bhramaieeaai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee ujhaR paieeaai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅੰਤਰ ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee a(n)tar te thothaa ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,

280.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਥਾ ॥
280.t: jiau saas binaa mritak kee lothaa ||
280.e: like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kee jaR kichh naeh ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.

280.g: ਆਪਨ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
280.t: aapan beej aape hee khaeh ||
280.e: He himself must eat what he has planted.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau avar na raakhanahaar ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
280.t: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa le ubaar ||5||
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਇਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee iau bilalai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this

280.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਇ ॥
280.t: jiau jal bihoon machhulee taRafaRai ||
280.e: like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee bhookhaa nahee raajai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,

280.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
280.t: jiau paavak ieedhan nahee dhraapai ||
280.e: as fire is not satisfied by fuel.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee chhuTai ikelaa ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,

280.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੂਆੜੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
280.t: jiau booaaR til khet maeh dhuhelaa ||
280.e: like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee dharam te rahat ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਹਤ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee sadh mithiaa kahat ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.

280.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੀ ਪਇਆ ॥
280.t: kirat ni(n)dhak kaa dhur hee piaa ||
280.e: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥਿਆ ॥੬॥
280.t: naanak jo tis bhaavai soiee thiaa ||6||
280.e: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee bigaR roop hoi jai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau dharageh milai sajai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਕਾਈਐ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee sadhaa sahakaieeaai ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee na marai na jeevaieeaai ||
280.e: He does not die, but he does not live either.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kee pujai na aasaa ||
280.e: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee uTh chalai niraasaa ||
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੋਖਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
280.t: sa(n)t kai dhokh na tirasaTai koi ||
280.e: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.

280.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
280.t: jaisaa bhaavai taisaa koiee hoi ||
280.e: As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;

280.g: ਪਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
280.t: piaa kirat na meTai koi ||
280.e: no one can erase their past actions.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
280.t: naanak jaanai sachaa soi ||7||
280.e: O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||

280.g: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
280.t: sabh ghaT tis ke oh karanaihaar ||
280.e: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.

280.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
280.t: sadhaa sadhaa tis kau namasakaar ||
280.e: Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.

280.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
280.t: prabh kee usatat karahu dhin raat ||
280.e: Praise God, day and night.

280.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
280.t: tiseh dhiaavahu saas giraas ||
280.e: Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.

280.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
280.t: sabh kachh varatai tis kaa keeaa ||
280.e: Everything happens as He wills.

280.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
280.t: jaisaa kare taisaa ko theeaa ||
280.e: As He wills, so people become.

280.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
280.t: apanaa khel aap karanaihaar ||
280.e: He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.

280.g: ਦੂਸਰ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
280.t: dhoosar kaun kahai beechaar ||
280.e: Who else can speak or deliberate upon this?

281.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
281.t: jis no kirapaa karai tis aapan naam dhei ||
281.e: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.
Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13||
Shalok:

281.g: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
281.t: tajahu siaanap sur janahu simarahu har har rai ||
281.e: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!

281.g: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
281.t: ek aas har man rakhahu naanak dhookh bharam bhau jai ||1||
281.e: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

281.g: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
281.t: maanukh kee Tek birathee sabh jaan ||
281.e: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.
The Great Giver is the One Lord God.
By His gifts, we are satisfied,
and we suffer from thirst no longer.
The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.
Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.

281.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
281.t: tis kaa hukam boojh sukh hoi ||
281.e: Understanding His Order, there is peace.

281.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
281.t: tis kaa naam rakh ka(n)Th paroi ||
281.e: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.
Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.
O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||
Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.
O my mind, make this your true occupation.
Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.
Your soul shall be forever peaceful.
With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.
In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.
With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.
Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.

281.g: ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
281.t: kar har karam sravan har kathaa ||
281.e: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.
In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||
Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,

281.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
281.t: sadhaa sadhaa har ke gun gaeh ||
281.e: who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.
Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,
are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

281.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
281.t: man tan mukh boleh har mukhee ||
281.e: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed
know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.
One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,

281.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
281.t: eit ut kee oh sojhee jaanai ||
281.e: understands this world and the next.

281.g: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
281.t: naam sa(n)g jis kaa man maaniaa ||
281.e: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,
the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||
By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;
know that then, his thirst is quenched.
In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

281.g: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ ॥
281.t: sarab rog te oh har jan rahat ||
281.e: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.
Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.
In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.

281.g: ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
281.t: ek uoopar jis jan kee aasaa ||
281.e: One who places his hopes in the One Lord

281.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
281.t: tis kee kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa ||
281.e: the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.
One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,
O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||

281.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
281.t: jis kau har prabh man chit aavai ||
281.e: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God
- that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.
Those unto whom God has granted His Grace

281.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
281.t: so sevak kahu kis te ddarai ||
281.e: who do those servants need to fear?
As God is, so does He appear;
in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.
Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!
By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.

281.g: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਬ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
281.t: jab dhekhau tab sabh kichh mool ||
281.e: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.
O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||

281.g: ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
281.t: neh kichh janamai neh kichh marai ||
281.e: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.
He Himself stages His own drama.
Coming and going, seen and unseen,
all the world is obedient to His Will.

282.e: He Himself is All-in-Himself.
In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.
He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.
He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.
Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.
As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||
Those who know God are glorious.
The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.
God's servants redeem all.
God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.
The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.

282.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
282.t: gur kaa sabadh jap bhe nihaal ||
282.e: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.
He alone is committed to serve them,
upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.
Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.

282.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
282.t: naanak tin purakh kau uootam kar maan ||7||
282.e: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||

282.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
282.t: jo kichh karai su prabh kai ra(n)g ||
282.e: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.
Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.
By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.
Acknowledge that Creator Lord;

282.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
282.t: prabh kaa keeaa jan meeTh lagaanaa ||
282.e: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.
As He is, so does He appear.

282.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
282.t: jis te upaje tis maeh samaae ||
282.e: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.

282.g: ਓਇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
282.t: oi sukh nidhaan unahoo ban aae ||
282.e: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.
Unto His own, He has given His honor.
O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14||
Shalok:

282.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ॥
282.t: sarab kalaa bharapoor prabh birathaa jaananahaar ||
282.e: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.

282.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
282.t: jaa kai simaran udhareeaai naanak tis balihaar ||1||
282.e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.
He Himself cherishes all beings.

282.g: ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
282.t: sagal kee chi(n)taa jis man maeh ||
282.e: The cares of all are on His Mind;
no one is turned away from Him.

282.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
282.t: re man mere sadhaa har jaap ||
282.e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.
The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.
By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,
even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

282.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
282.t: tis bin naahee terai kichh kaam ||
282.e: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.

282.g: ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
282.t: gat naanak jap ek har naam ||1||
282.e: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||
One who is good-looking should not be vain;

282.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
282.t: prabh kee jot sagal ghaT sohai ||
282.e: the Light of God is in all hearts.
Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

282.g: ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਦਰਬੈ ॥
282.t: jaa sabh kichh tis kaa dheeaa dharabai ||
282.e: All riches are His gifts.
One may call himself a great hero,

282.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
282.t: prabh kee kalaa binaa keh dhaavai ||
282.e: but without God's Power, what can anyone do?
One who brags about giving to charities
the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

282.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂਟੈ ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
282.t: jis gur prasaadh tooTai hau rog ||
282.e: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego
- O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||
As a palace is supported by its pillars,

282.g: ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਸਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
282.t: tiau gur kaa sabadh maneh asatha(n)man ||
282.e: so does the Guru's Word support the mind.
As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,
so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.
As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,

282.g: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
282.t: gur dharasan dhekh man hoi bigaas ||
282.e: so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

282.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
282.t: jiau mahaa udhiaan meh maarag paavai || tiau saadhoo sa(n)g mil jot pragaTaavai ||
282.e: The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.
I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;
O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||
O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?

283.e: You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.
God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.
Abandon others, and think of Him alone.

283.g: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
283.t: jo kachh karai soiee sukh maan ||
283.e: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.
Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?
What things did you bring with you?
You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.
Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.
O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||

283.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
283.t: jis vakhar kau lain too aaiaa ||
283.e: This merchandise, which you have come to obtain
the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.

283.g: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੋਲਿ ॥ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
283.t: taj abhimaan leh man mol || raam naam hiradhe meh tol ||
283.e: Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind, purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.
Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.
Give up other corrupt entanglements.
"Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,
and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.
In this trade, only a few are trading.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||

283.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
283.t: charan saadh ke dhoi dhoi peeau ||
283.e: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.
Dedicate your soul to the Holy.
Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.
Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.
From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.

283.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
283.t: har gun gai a(n)mirat ras chaakhai ||
283.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.
Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.
All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||
He infuses life back into the dead.
He gives food to the hungry.

283.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
283.t: sarab nidhaan jaa kee dhirasaTee maeh ||
283.e: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.
People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.

283.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
283.t: sabh kichh tis kaa oh karanai jog ||
283.e: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.

283.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
283.t: tis bin dhoosar hoaa na hog ||
283.e: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.

283.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
283.t: jap jan sadhaa sadhaa dhin rainee ||
283.e: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.

283.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
283.t: sabh te uooch niramal ieh karanee ||
283.e: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.

283.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
283.t: kar kirapaa jis kau naam dheeaa ||
283.e: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name
- O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||

283.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
283.t: jaa kai man gur kee parateet ||
283.e: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind

283.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
283.t: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
283.e: comes to dwell upon the Lord God.
He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.
The One Lord is in his heart.

283.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
283.t: sach karanee sach taa kee rahat ||
283.e: True are his actions; true are his ways.
True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.
True is his vision; true is his form.
He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.
One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True
- O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15||
Shalok:

283.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
283.t: roop na rekh na ra(n)g kichh tirahu gun te prabh bhi(n)n ||
283.e: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.

283.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੧॥
283.t: tiseh bujhaae naanakaa jis hovai suprasa(n)n ||1||
283.e: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.
Renounce your love and attachment to people.

283.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
283.t: tis te parai naahee kichh koi ||
283.e: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.
The One Lord is pervading among all.
He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,
Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.
He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,
the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.
To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings

284.e: - this is the longing of Nanak's mind. ||1||
The one who fulfills wishes and gives us Sanctuary.
That which He has written, comes to pass.

284.g: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੋਰੁ ॥
284.t: haran bharan jaa kaa netr for ||
284.e: He destroys and creates in the blink of an eye.

284.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
284.t: tis kaa ma(n)tr na jaanai hor ||
284.e: No one else knows the mystery of His ways.

284.g: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
284.t: anadh roop ma(n)gal sadh jaa kai ||
284.e: He is the embodiment of ecstasy and everlasting joy.

284.g: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਸੁਨੀਅਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
284.t: sarab thok sune'eeh ghar taa kai ||
284.e: I have heard that all things are in His home.

284.g: ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
284.t: raaj meh raaj jog meh jogee ||
284.e: Among kings, He is the King; among yogis, He is the Yogi.

284.g: ਤਪ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
284.t: tap meh tapeesar girahasat meh bhogee ||
284.e: Among ascetics, He is the Ascetic; among householders, He is the Consummator.
By the constant practice of meditation, His devotee finds peace.

284.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
284.t: naanak tis purakh kaa kinai a(n)t na paiaa ||2||
284.e: O Nanak, no one has found the limits of that Supreme Being. ||2||

284.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
284.t: jaa kee leelaa kee mit naeh ||
284.e: There is no limit to His play.
All the demigods have grown weary of searching for it.

284.g: ਪਿਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
284.t: pitaa kaa janam k jaanai poot ||
284.e: What does the son know of his father's birth?
All are strung upon His string.

284.g: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਜਨ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
284.t: sumat giaan dhiaan jin dhei || jan dhaas naam dhiaaveh sei ||
284.e: He bestows good sense, spiritual wisdom and meditation on His humble servants and slaves who meditate on the Naam.

284.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
284.t: tih gun meh jaa kau bharamaae ||
284.e: He leads some astray in the three qualities;
they are born and die, coming and going over and over again.
The high and the low are His places.
As He inspires us to know Him, O Nanak, so is He known. ||3||

284.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
284.t: naanaa roop naanaa jaa ke ra(n)g ||
284.e: Many are His forms; many are His colors.
Many are the appearances which He assumes, and yet He is still the One.
In so many ways, He has extended Himself.
The Eternal Lord God is the One, the Creator.
He performs His many plays in an instant.
The Perfect Lord is pervading all places.
In so many ways, He created the creation.
He alone can estimate His worth.

284.g: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
284.t: sabh ghaT tis ke sabh tis ke Thaau ||
284.e: All hearts are His, and all places are His.

284.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
284.t: jap jap jeevai naanak har naau ||4||
284.e: Nanak lives by chanting, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||4||
The Naam is the Support of all creatures.
The Naam is the Support of the earth and solar systems.

284.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
284.t: naam ke dhaare simirat bedh puraan ||
284.e: The Naam is the Support of the Simritees, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

284.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸੁਨਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
284.t: naam ke dhaare sunan giaan dhiaan ||
284.e: The Naam is the Support by which we hear of spiritual wisdom and meditation.
The Naam is the Support of the Akaashic ethers and the nether regions.
The Naam is the Support of all bodies.

284.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਭਵਨ ॥
284.t: naam ke dhaare pureeaa sabh bhavan ||
284.e: The Naam is the Support of all worlds and realms.

284.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
284.t: naam kai sa(n)g udhare sun sravan ||
284.e: Associating with the Naam, listening to it with the ears, one is saved.

284.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਨੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
284.t: kar kirapaa jis aapanai naam laae ||
284.e: Those whom the Lord mercifully attaches to His Naam

284.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
284.t: naanak chauthe padh meh so jan gat paae ||5||
284.e: - O Nanak, in the fourth state, those humble servants attain salvation. ||5||

284.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
284.t: roop sat jaa kaa sat asathaan ||
284.e: His form is true, and true is His place.
His personality is true - He alone is supreme.

284.g: ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
284.t: karatoot sat sat jaa kee baanee ||
284.e: His acts are true, and true is His Word.
The True Lord is permeating all.

284.g: ਸਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
284.t: sat karam jaa kee rachanaa sat ||
284.e: True are His actions; His creation is true.
His root is true, and true is what originates from it.
True is His lifestyle, the purest of the pure.
All goes well for those who know Him.
The True Name of God is the Giver of peace.

284.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
284.t: bisavaiaas sat naanak gur te paiee ||6||
284.e: Nanak has obtained true faith from the Guru. ||6||
True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.

284.g: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥
284.t: sat te jan jaa kai ridhai praves ||
284.e: True are those into whose hearts He enters.
One who knows and loves the Truth

284.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
284.t: naam japat taa kee gat hoi ||
284.e: chanting the Naam, he obtains salvation.
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is true.
He Himself knows His own state and condition.

285.e: He is the Creator Lord of His world.
No one else understands Him, although they may try.

285.g: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
285.t: karate kee mit na jaanai keeaa ||
285.e: The created cannot know the extent of the Creator.

285.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਵਰਤੀਆ ॥੭॥
285.t: naanak jo tis bhaavai so varateeaa ||7||
285.e: O Nanak, whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ||7||
Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!
One who realizes this, comes to taste this state of joy.

285.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
285.t: prabh kai ra(n)g raach jan rahe ||
285.e: God's humble servants remain absorbed in His Love.
Following the Guru's Teachings, they receive the four cardinal blessings.
They are the givers, the dispellers of pain.
In their company, the world is saved.
The slave of the Lord's servant is so very blessed.

285.g: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
285.t: jan kai sa(n)g ek liv laagee ||
285.e: In the company of His servant, one becomes attached to the Love of the One.
His humble servant sings the Kirtan, the songs of the glory of God.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, he receives the fruits of his rewards. ||8||16||
Shalok:
True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

285.g: ਹੈ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
285.t: hai bh sach naanak hosee bh sach ||1||
285.e: True here and now. O Nanak, He shall forever be True. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
His Lotus Feet are True, and True are those who touch Them.
His devotional worship is True, and True are those who worship Him.
The Blessing of His Vision is True, and True are those who behold it.
His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.
He Himself is True, and True is all that He sustains.
He Himself is virtuous goodness, and He Himself is the Bestower of virtue.
The Word of His Shabad is True, and True are those who speak of God.
Those ears are True, and True are those who listen to His Praises.
All is True to one who understands.
O Nanak, True, True is He, the Lord God. ||1||
One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart
recognizes the Cause of causes as the Root of all.

285.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥
285.t: jaa kai ridhai bisavaiaas prabh aaiaa ||
285.e: One whose heart is filled with faith in God
the essence of spiritual wisdom is revealed to his mind.
Coming out of fear, he comes to live without fear.

285.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
285.t: jis te upajiaa tis maeh samaanaa ||
285.e: He is absorbed into the One, from whom he originated.
When something blends with its own,

285.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕਹਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
285.t: taa kau bhi(n)n na kahanaa jaiee ||
285.e: it cannot be said to be separate from it.
This is understood only by one of discerning understanding.
Meeting with the Lord, O Nanak, he becomes one with Him. ||2||
The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.
The servant worships his Lord and Master forever.

285.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
285.t: Thaakur ke sevak kai man parateet ||
285.e: The servant of the Lord Master has faith in his mind.

285.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
285.t: Thaakur ke sevak kee niramal reet ||
285.e: The servant of the Lord Master lives a pure lifestyle.
The servant of the Lord Master knows that the Lord is with him.

285.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
285.t: prabh kaa sevak naam kai ra(n)g ||
285.e: God's servant is attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
God is the Cherisher of His servant.
The Formless Lord preserves His servant.

285.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
285.t: so sevak jis dhiaa prabh dhaarai ||
285.e: Unto His servant, God bestows His Mercy.

285.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
285.t: naanak so sevak saas saas samaarai ||3||
285.e: O Nanak, that servant remembers Him with each and every breath. ||3||
He covers the faults of His servant.
He surely preserves the honor of His servant.
He blesses His slave with greatness.
He inspires His servant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

285.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
285.t: apane sevak kee aap pat raakhai ||
285.e: He Himself preserves the honor of His servant.

285.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
285.t: taa kee gat mit koi na laakhai ||
285.e: No one knows His state and extent.

285.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
285.t: prabh ke sevak kau ko na pahoochai ||
285.e: No one is equal to the servant of God.

285.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
285.t: prabh ke sevak uooch te uooche ||
285.e: The servant of God is the highest of the high.
One whom God applies to His own service, O Nanak

285.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
285.t: naanak so sevak dheh dhis pragaTaiaa ||4||
285.e: - that servant is famous in the ten directions. ||4||
He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;
it can then reduce the armies of millions to ashes

285.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਢਤ ਆਪਿ ॥
285.t: jis kaa saas na kaaddat aap ||
285.e: Those whose breath of life He Himself does not take away

286.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
286.t: taa kau raakhat dhe kar haath ||
286.e: He preserves them, and holds out His Hands to protect them.
You may make all sorts of efforts,
but these attempts are in vain.

286.g: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
286.t: maarai na raakhai avar na koi ||
286.e: No one else can kill or preserve
He is the Protector of all beings.
So why are you so anxious, O mortal?
Meditate, O Nanak, on God, the invisible, the wonderful! ||5||
Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.

286.g: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਪੀਐ ॥
286.t: pee a(n)mrit ih man tan dhrapeeaai ||
286.e: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.
The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;
they see no other than God.
Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.

286.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
286.t: naamo sukh har naam kaa sa(n)g ||
286.e: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.
Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam
their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.
While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,

286.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
286.t: kahu naanak jan kai sadh kaam ||6||
286.e: says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||
Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.
God Himself has given this gift to His servants.
Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,
they remain absorbed in God Himself.
They know the past and the present.
They recognize God's Own Command.
Who can describe His Glory?

286.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
286.t: tis kaa gun keh ek na jaanau ||
286.e: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.
Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day
- says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

286.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
286.t: man mere tin kee oT leh ||
286.e: O my mind, seek their protection;

286.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
286.t: man tan apanaa tin jan dheh ||
286.e: give your mind and body to those humble beings.
Those humble beings who recognizes God

286.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
286.t: so jan sarab thok kaa dhaataa ||
286.e: are the givers of all things.

286.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
286.t: tis kee saran sarab sukh paaveh ||
286.e: In His Sanctuary, all comforts are obtained.

286.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਾਵਹਿ ॥
286.t: tis kai dharas sabh paap miTaaveh ||
286.e: By the Blessing of His Darshan, all sins are erased.
So renounce all other clever devices,

286.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
286.t: tis jan kee too sevaa laag ||
286.e: and enjoin yourself to the service of those servants.
Your comings and goings shall be ended.

286.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਸਦ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
286.t: naanak tis jan ke poojahu sadh pairaa ||8||17||
286.e: O Nanak, worship the feet of God's humble servants forever. ||8||17||
Shalok:

286.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
286.t: sat purakh jin jaaniaa satigur tis kaa naau ||
286.e: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.

286.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
286.t: tis kai sa(n)g sikh udharai naanak har gun gaau ||1||
286.e: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.
The Guru is always merciful to His servant.

286.g: ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
286.t: sikh kee gur dhuramat mal hirai ||
286.e: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.
Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.
The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.

286.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੈ ॥
286.t: gur kaa sikh bikaar te haaTai ||
286.e: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.

286.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
286.t: satigur sikh kau naam dhan dhei ||
286.e: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.
The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.

286.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
286.t: satigur sikh kaa halat palat savaarai ||
286.e: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.

286.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
286.t: naanak satigur sikh kau jeea naal samaarai ||1||
286.e: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||

286.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
286.t: gur kai gireh sevak jo rahai ||
286.e: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

286.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
286.t: gur kee aagiaa man meh sahai ||
286.e: is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

286.g: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
286.t: aapas kau kar kachh na janaavai ||
286.e: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.

286.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
286.t: har har naam ridhai sadh dhiaavai ||
286.e: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.
One who sells his mind to the True Guru
- that humble servant's affairs are resolved.
One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,
shall attain his Lord and Master.

287.e: He Himself grants His Grace;

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
287.t: naanak so sevak gur kee mat lei ||2||
287.e: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

287.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
287.t: bees bisave gur kaa man maanai ||
287.e: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent

287.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
287.t: so sevak paramesur kee gat jaanai ||
287.e: that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

287.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
287.t: so satigur jis ridhai har naau ||
287.e: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.

287.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
287.t: anik baar gur kau bal jaau ||
287.e: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.
Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

287.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
287.t: braham meh jan jan meh paarabraham ||
287.e: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.
He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.
By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.
O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||
Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.
Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.
Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,
and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.
Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.
The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.

287.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੵਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ॥
287.t: pooraa gur akhayeo jaa kaa ma(n)tr ||
287.e: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.
Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.
Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
287.t: naanak jis bhaavai tis le milai ||4||
287.e: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||
The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.

287.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
287.t: sat purakh pooran bibek || kaahoo bol na pahuchat praanee ||
287.e: The True Lord, of perfect perfection - no speech can take the mortal to Him.
God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.
He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.

287.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
287.t: taa kee keemat kinai na paiee ||
287.e: No one can estimate His worth.
Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.
In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੫॥
287.t: naanak jis prasaadh aaisaa prabh japane ||5||
287.e: by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||

287.g: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
287.t: eih har ras paavai jan koi ||
287.e: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.
Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.

287.g: ਉਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
287.t: aus purakh kaa naahee kadhe binaas || jaa kai man pragaTe gunataas ||
287.e: That person whose mind is illuminated by the treasure of excellence, never dies.

287.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
287.t: aaTh pahar har kaa naam lei ||
287.e: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.
The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.

287.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
287.t: moh maiaa kai sa(n)g na lep ||
287.e: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.

287.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
287.t: man meh raakhai har har ek ||
287.e: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.
In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
287.t: naanak bharam moh dhukh teh te naase ||6||
287.e: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||
In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.
Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.
The fear of birth and death is dispelled,
by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.
Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.

287.g: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਖੈ ਨਸੇ ॥
287.t: sagal biaadh man te khai nase ||
287.e: All evils are dispelled from the mind.

287.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
287.t: jis kaa saa tin kirapaa dhaaree ||
287.e: He takes us into His favor as His own.
In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,

287.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥੭॥
287.t: sun naanak har har jas sravan ||7||
287.e: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||
He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.
Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.
God Himself sets His play in motion.
Only He Himself can estimate His worth.
There is none, other than the Lord.
Permeating all, He is the One.
Through and through, He pervades in form and color.
He is revealed in the Company of the Holy.

288.e: Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.
So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18||
Shalok:

288.g: ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
288.t: saath na chaalai bin bhajan bikhiaa sagalee chhaar ||
288.e: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.

288.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
288.t: har har naam kamaavanaa naanak ih dhan saar ||1||
288.e: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.
Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Forget all other efforts, O my friend

288.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
288.t: charan kamal ridh meh ur dhaarahu ||
288.e: - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.
God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.

288.g: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
288.t: dhiraR kar gahahu naam har vath ||
288.e: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.
Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.
Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.
Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.
All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||

288.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
288.t: jis dhan kau chaar ku(n)T uTh dhaaveh ||
288.e: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions

288.g: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
288.t: so dhan har sevaa te paaveh ||
288.e: you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

288.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
288.t: jis sukh kau nit baachheh meet ||
288.e: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend
that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

288.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਕਰਨੀ ॥
288.t: jis sobhaa kau kareh bhalee karanee ||
288.e: The glory, for which you perform good deeds

288.g: ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ॥
288.t: saa sobhaa bhaj har kee saranee ||
288.e: - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.
All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease
- the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

288.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
288.t: sarab nidhaan meh har naam nidhaan ||
288.e: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.
Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.
Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.

288.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
288.t: taa kau bighan na laagai koi ||
288.e: No obstacle stands in the way of one

288.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
288.t: jaa kai ridhai basai har soi ||
288.e: whose heart is filled with the Lord.
The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.
Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.
Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.
By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.
You shall go to that home, and live forever.
Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||
One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.
Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.
Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.
Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.

288.g: ਇਉ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
288.t: eiau ratan janam kaa hoi udhaar ||
288.e: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.
Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.
By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved
not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

288.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
288.t: har kee bhagat karahu man lai ||
288.e: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||
Your wealth shall not go with you;
why do you cling to it, you fool?
Children, friends, family and spouse

288.g: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਕਵਨ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
288.t: ein te kahahu tum kavan sanaathaa ||
288.e: who of these shall accompany you?
Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya
who has ever escaped from these?
Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry
- false shows and false displays.

288.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
288.t: jin dhe'ee tis bujhai na bigaanaa ||
288.e: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;
forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||

288.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
288.t: gur kee mat too(n) leh iaane ||
288.e: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;
without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

288.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
288.t: har kee bhagat karahu man meet ||
288.e: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;
your consciousness shall become pure.
Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind;

289.e: the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.
Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.

289.g: ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
289.t: saar bhoot sat har ko naau ||
289.e: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.
With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||
Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.
The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.
You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.
With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.
Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.
In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.
So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.
In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be acclaimed.
See the One permeating all;

289.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
289.t: kahu naanak jaa kai masatak lekh ||7||
289.e: says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||
Meditate on the One, and worship the One.
Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.
Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.
With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.
The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.
The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.
The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.
Adoring the One, past sins are removed.

289.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
289.t: man tan a(n)tar ek prabh raataa ||
289.e: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19||
Shalok:

289.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
289.t: firat firat prabh aaiaa pariaa tau saranai ||
289.e: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.

289.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
289.t: naanak kee prabh benatee apanee bhagatee lai ||1||
289.e: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:
please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.
I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;

289.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
289.t: sadhaa sadhaa prabh ke gun gaavau ||
289.e: may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.
With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.
May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.

289.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
289.t: bhagat karau prabh kee nit neet ||
289.e: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.
You are my only Shelter, my only Support.
Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||

289.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
289.t: prabh kee dhirasaT mahaa sukh hoi ||
289.e: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.
Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.
Those who taste it are satisfied.
They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.
They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.
Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.
Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.
Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||
The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.
From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.
Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.
He has made His servant eternally happy.
The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.
The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.
Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,
imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

289.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
289.t: jis kaa saa tin leeaa milai ||
289.e: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.
Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||

289.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
289.t: so kiau bisarai j ghaal na bhaanai ||
289.e: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

289.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
289.t: so kiau bisarai j keeaa jaanai ||
289.e: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
290.t: so kiau bisarai jin sabh kichh dheeaa ||
290.e: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
290.t: so kiau bisarai j jeevan jeeaa ||
290.e: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
290.t: so kiau bisarai j agan meh raakhai ||
290.e: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?
By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
290.t: so kiau bisarai j bikh te kaaddai ||
290.e: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?
Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.
Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.
O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||
O friends, O Saints, make this your work.
Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.
By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.
All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.
Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.
All sorrows shall vanish.
O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||
Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;
within my mind and body, this is my purpose:
beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.
My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

290.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
290.t: bhagat janaa kai man tan ra(n)g ||
290.e: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.
Rare is the one who obtains their company.
Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:
by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

290.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
290.t: taa kee upamaa kahee na jai ||
290.e: His Praises cannot be spoken;
O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||
God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.
He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.
The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,
the Nourisher of all beings.
The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.
The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

290.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
290.t: jo jo japai su hoi puneet ||
290.e: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,
focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.
I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.
Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||
Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,

290.g: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
290.t: ek nimakh har ke gun gaae ||
290.e: if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.
So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,

290.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
290.t: har ke naam kee kathaa man bhaiee ||
290.e: come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.
Abundant foods, clothes and music
come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;
the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.
O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.
All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20||
Shalok:

290.g: ਸਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
290.t: saragun niragun nira(n)kaar su(n)n samaadhee aap ||
290.e: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.

290.g: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
290.t: aapan keeaa naanakaa aape hee fir jaap ||1||
290.e: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

290.g: ਜਬ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
290.t: jab akaar ih kachh na dhirasaTetaa ||
290.e: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,

290.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਬ ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
290.t: paap pu(n)n tab keh te hotaa ||
290.e: who then committed sins and performed good deeds?
When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,

290.g: ਤਬ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
290.t: tab bair birodh kis sa(n)g kamaat ||
290.e: then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

290.g: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
290.t: jab is kaa baran chihan na jaapat ||
290.e: When there was no color or shape to be seen,

290.g: ਤਬ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
290.t: tab harakh sog kahu kiseh biaapat ||
290.e: then who experienced joy and sorrow?
When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,

290.g: ਤਬ ਮੋਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਰਮ ॥
290.t: tab moh kahaa kis hovat bharam ||
290.e: then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts?

291.e: He Himself has staged His own drama;
O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||
When there was only God the Master,

291.g: ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ ॥
291.t: tab ba(n)dh mukat kahu kis kau ganee ||
291.e: then who was called bound or liberated?
When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,

291.g: ਤਬ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
291.t: tab narak surag kahu kaun aautaar ||
291.e: then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?
When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,

291.g: ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
291.t: tab siv sakat kahahu kit Thai ||
291.e: then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

291.g: ਜਬ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
291.t: jab aapeh aap apanee jot dharai ||
291.e: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,

291.g: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਡਰੁ ਕਵਨ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ॥
291.t: tab kavan niddar kavan kat ddarai ||
291.e: then who was fearless, and who was afraid?
He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;
O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||
When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

291.g: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
291.t: teh janam maran kahu kahaa binaasan ||
291.e: then where was birth, death and dissolution?
When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,

291.g: ਤਬ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
291.t: tab jam kee traas kahahu kis hoi ||
291.e: then who was afraid of death?
When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,

291.g: ਤਬ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਤ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
291.t: tab chitr gupat kis poochhat lekhaa ||
291.e: then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?
When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,

291.g: ਤਬ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਕਉਨ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
291.t: tab kaun chhuTe kaun ba(n)dhan baadhe ||
291.e: then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?
He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.

291.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਰੂਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ ॥੩॥
291.t: naanak aapan roop aap hee uparajaa ||3||
291.e: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||

291.g: ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
291.t: jeh niramal purakh purakh pat hotaa ||
291.e: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

291.g: ਤਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਤਾ ॥
291.t: teh bin mail kahahu kiaa dhotaa ||
291.e: there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?
When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਨ ਕਉਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
291.t: teh kaun kau maan kaun abhimaan ||
291.e: then who was honored, and who was dishonored?
When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,

291.g: ਤਹ ਛਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਗਤ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਸ ॥
291.t: teh chhal chhidhr lagat kahu kees ||
291.e: then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

291.g: ਜਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
291.t: jeh jot saroopee jot sa(n)g samaavai ||
291.e: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,
then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?
He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.
O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||

291.g: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
291.t: jab apanee sobhaa aapan sa(n)g banaiee ||
291.e: When His Glory was contained within Himself,

291.g: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
291.t: tab kavan mai baap mitr sut bhaiee ||
291.e: then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?
When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,

291.g: ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
291.t: teh bedh kateb kahaa kouoo cheen ||
291.e: then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

291.g: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
291.t: jab aapan aap aap ur dhaarai ||
291.e: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,
then who considered omens to be good or bad?

291.g: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
291.t: jeh aapan uooch aapan aap neraa ||
291.e: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
291.t: teh kaun Thaakur kaun kaheeaai cheraa ||
291.e: then who was called master, and who was called disciple?
We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.
O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||
When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,
then who was swayed by Maya?
When He paid homage to Himself,
then the three qualities were not prevailing.
When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
291.t: teh kaun achi(n)t kis laagai chi(n)taa ||
291.e: then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?
When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,
then who spoke and who listened?
He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.
O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||
When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,
he made the world subject to the three dispositions.
Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.

292.e: Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.
Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,
egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;
pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor
these came to be described in various ways.
He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.
He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||
Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.
He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
His Praise is to Himself alone.
He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.
He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.

292.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
292.t: jis bhaavai tis aapan nai laavai ||
292.e: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.
He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.
He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.

292.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
292.t: jiau bulaavahu tiau naanak dhaas bolai ||8||21||
292.e: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21||
Shalok:

292.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ ॥
292.t: jeea ja(n)t ke Thaakuraa aape varatanahaar ||
292.e: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailing everywhere.

292.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
292.t: naanak eko pasariaa dhoojaa keh dhirasaTaar ||1||
292.e: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1||
Ashtapadee:
He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

292.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
292.t: jaa tis bhaavai taa sirasaT upaae ||
292.e: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.
As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.

292.g: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
292.t: tum te bhi(n)n nahee kichh hoi ||
292.e: Without You, nothing can be done.
Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.

292.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
292.t: jaa kau prabh jeeau aap bujhaae ||
292.e: One whom God Himself inspires to understand
- that person obtains the True Name.
He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.
O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||

292.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
292.t: jeea ja(n)tr sabh taa kai haath ||
292.e: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.
He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.

292.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
292.t: jis raakhai tis koi na maarai ||
292.e: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.
One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.

292.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
292.t: tis taj avar kahaa ko jai ||
292.e: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?
Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.

292.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
292.t: jeea kee jugat jaa kai sabh haath ||
292.e: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.
Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.
He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.
Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||
The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.
His kindness extends to all.
He Himself knows His own ways.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.
He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.

292.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਤਿ ॥
292.t: jo jo rachio su tiseh dhiaat ||
292.e: That which He has created meditates on Him.
Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.

292.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
292.t: bhagat kareh har ke gun gai ||
292.e: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.
O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||
The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.

292.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
292.t: tis kee aas na birathee jai ||
292.e: His hopes do not go in vain.
The servant's purpose is to serve;
obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.
Beyond this, he has no other thought.
Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.
His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.
Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.
He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next.

293.e: O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||
Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.
Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.
Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.

293.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
293.t: a(n)mirat bachan har ke gun gaau ||
293.e: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;
this is the way to save your mortal soul.
Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.
Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.
Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||
Embellish both this world and the next;
enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.
Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

293.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
293.t: jis man basai tis saach pareekhiaa ||
293.e: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.

293.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
293.t: man tan naam japahu liv lai ||
293.e: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.

293.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
293.t: dhookh dharadh man te bhau jai ||
293.e: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.
Deal in the true trade, O trader,
and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.
Keep the Support of the One in your mind.
O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||

293.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
293.t: tis te dhoor kahaa ko jai ||
293.e: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?
Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.
Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.
By God's Grace, mortals are released.

293.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ॥
293.t: jis prabh raakhai tis naahee dhookh ||
293.e: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.
Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.
Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.

293.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
293.t: tis jan kau koi na pahuchanahaar ||
293.e: No one can equal that humble servant.
The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.
O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||

293.g: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
293.t: mat pooree a(n)mrit jaa kee dhirasaT ||
293.e: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.
Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.
His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.
The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.
Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.

293.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
293.t: jis man basai su hot nihaal ||
293.e: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.

293.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
293.t: taa kai nikaT na aavat kaal ||
293.e: Death does not draw near him.
One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,
meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22||
Shalok:

293.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
293.t: giaan a(n)jan gur dheeaa agiaan a(n)dher binaas ||
293.e: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.

293.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
293.t: har kirapaa te sa(n)t bheTiaa naanak man paragaas ||1||
293.e: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.
God's Name is sweet to me.
All things are contained in the Heart of the One,
although they appear in so many various colors.

293.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
293.t: nau nidh a(n)mrit prabh kaa naam ||
293.e: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.
Within the human body is its place of rest.
The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.
The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.
He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.
O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||
The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.
Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.
In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld
in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher.

294.e: In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.
As He orders, so do His creatures act.
He permeates the winds and the waters.
He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.

294.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
294.t: tis te bhi(n)n nahee ko Thaau ||
294.e: Without Him, there is no place at all.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||
See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.

294.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
294.t: baanee prabh kee sabh ko bolai ||
294.e: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.
He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.
With absolute power, He plays His play.
His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.

294.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
294.t: sarab jot meh jaa kee jot ||
294.e: In all light, is His Light.
The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.
By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||

294.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
294.t: sa(n)t janaa kaa pekhan sabh braham ||
294.e: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.

294.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
294.t: sa(n)t janaa kai hiradhai sabh dharam ||
294.e: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.
The Saint hears words of goodness.
He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.

294.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰਹਤ ॥
294.t: jin jaataa tis kee ieh rahat ||
294.e: This is the way of life of one who knows God.
True are all the words spoken by the Holy.

294.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
294.t: jo jo hoi soiee sukh maanai ||
294.e: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.
He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He dwells inside, and outside as well.
O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.
The entire creation came from God.
As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.
As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.
His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.
As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.
Who is near, and who is far away?
He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.
One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart
- O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||
In all forms, He Himself is pervading.
Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.
All the creation is His Body.
He Himself listens to His Own Praise.
The One has created the drama of coming and going.
He made Maya subservient to His Will.
In the midst of all, He remains unattached.

294.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੈ ॥
294.t: jo kichh kahanaa su aape kahai ||
294.e: Whatever is said, He Himself says.
By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.

294.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
294.t: naanak jaa bhaavai taa le samai ||6||
294.e: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||

294.g: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
294.t: eis te hoi su naahee buraa ||
294.e: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.
Other than Him, who can do anything?
He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.
He Himself knows His Own Being.
He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.
Through and through, He is blended with His creation.

294.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
294.t: taa kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
294.e: His state and extent cannot be described.
If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.
His actions are all approved and accepted.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||

294.g: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
294.t: jo jaanai tis sadhaa sukh hoi ||
294.e: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.
God blends that one into Himself.
He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.
He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.
Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;

295.e: by his grace, the whole world is saved.
This is his purpose in life;

295.g: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
295.t: jan kai sa(n)g chit aavai naau ||
295.e: in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.
He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.

295.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨੩॥
295.t: naanak tis jan kau sadhaa namasakaar ||8||23||
295.e: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23||
Shalok:

295.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
295.t: pooraa prabh aaraadhiaa pooraa jaa kaa naau ||
295.e: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.
