295.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
295.t: naanak pooraa paiaa poore ke gun gaau ||1||
295.e: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Lord. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;
see the Supreme Lord God near you.
With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,
and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.
Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,

295.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
295.t: sa(n)t janaa kee dhoor man ma(n)g ||
295.e: and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.
Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.

295.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
295.t: har dhan ke bhar leh bha(n)ddaar ||
295.e: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.
Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||
Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss
in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.
You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!
Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord

295.g: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
295.t: ek roop jaa ke ra(n)g anek ||
295.e: He has One Form, but He has many manifestations.
Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,
Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.
O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||
The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.
These are priceless rubies and gems.
One who listens and acts on them is saved.
He himself swims across, and saves others as well.

295.g: ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
295.t: safal jeevan safal taa kaa sa(n)g ||
295.e: His life is prosperous, and his company is fruitful;

295.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
295.t: jaa kai man laagaa har ra(n)g ||
295.e: his mind is imbued with the love of the Lord.
Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.

295.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
295.t: sun sun anadh kare prabh gaajai ||
295.e: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.
The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.
Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||
Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.
Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

295.g: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਬੈਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਰੇਨ ॥
295.t: miT ge bair bhe sabh ren ||
295.e: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.
I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.
The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;
the service of His servant has been rewarded.
I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,
hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.
By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.
O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||

295.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
295.t: prabh kee usatat karahu sa(n)t meet ||
295.e: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,
with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.
Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.

295.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
295.t: jis man basai su hot nidhaan ||
295.e: When it abides in the mind, one becomes wealthy.

295.g: ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
295.t: sarab ichhaa taa kee pooran hoi ||
295.e: All desires are fulfilled.
One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.
He obtains the highest place of all.
He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.

295.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
295.t: har dhan khaaT chalai jan soi ||
295.e: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,
O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||
Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;
wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;
learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God;

296.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
296.t: giaan sresaT uootam isanaan ||
296.e: The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;

296.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
296.t: chaar padhaarath kamal pragaas ||
296.e: the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

296.g: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
296.t: sabh kai madh sagal te udhaas ||
296.e: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;

296.g: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
296.t: su(n)dhar chatur tat kaa betaa ||
296.e: beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;

296.g: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
296.t: samadharasee ek dhirasaTetaa ||
296.e: to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

296.g: ਇਹ ਫਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
296.t: eeh fal tis jan kai mukh bhane || gur naanak naam bachan man sune ||6||
296.e: - these blessings come to one who, through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||

296.g: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
296.t: eih nidhaan japai man koi ||
296.e: One who chants this treasure in his mind

296.g: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
296.t: sabh jug meh taa kee gat hoi ||
296.e: in every age, he attains salvation.

296.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
296.t: gun gobi(n)dh naam dhun baanee ||
296.e: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.

296.g: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਬਖਾਣੀ ॥
296.t: simirat saasatr bedh bakhaanee ||
296.e: The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.

296.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਤਾਂਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
296.t: sagal mataa(n)t keval har naam ||
296.e: The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.

296.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
296.t: gobi(n)dh bhagat kai man bisraam ||
296.e: It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.

296.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
296.t: koT apraadh saadhasa(n)g miTai ||
296.e: Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

296.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
296.t: sa(n)t kirapaa te jam te chhuTai ||
296.e: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.

296.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
296.t: jaa kai masatak karam prabh paae ||
296.e: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,

296.g: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
296.t: saadh saran naanak te aae ||7||
296.e: O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

296.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
296.t: jis man basai sunai lai preet ||
296.e: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

296.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
296.t: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
296.e: that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

296.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
296.t: janam maran taa kaa dhookh nivaarai ||
296.e: The pains of birth and death are removed.

296.g: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
296.t: dhulabh dheh tatakaal udhaarai ||
296.e: The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

296.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
296.t: niramal sobhaa a(n)mirat taa kee baanee ||
296.e: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.

296.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
296.t: ek naam man maeh samaanee ||
296.e: The One Name permeates his mind.

296.g: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
296.t: dhookh rog binase bhai bharam ||
296.e: Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

296.g: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
296.t: saadh naam niramal taa ke karam ||
296.e: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

296.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
296.t: sabh te uooch taa kee sobhaa banee ||
296.e: His glory becomes the highest of all.

296.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਗੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ॥੮॥੨੪॥
296.t: naanak ieh gun naam sukhamanee ||8||24||
296.e: O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||

296.g: ਥਿਤੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
296.t: thitee gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
296.e: T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehla,

296.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
296.t: salok ||
296.e: Shalok:

296.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
296.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
296.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

296.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
296.t: jal thal maheeal pooriaa suaamee sirajanahaar ||
296.e: The Creator Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land, and the sky.

296.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
296.t: anik bhaa(n)t hoi pasariaa naanak eka(n)kaar ||1||
296.e: In so many ways, the One, the Universal Creator has diffused Himself, O Nanak. ||1||

296.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
296.t: pauRee ||
296.e: Pauree:

296.g: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
296.t: ekam eka(n)kaar prabh karau ba(n)dhanaa dhiaai ||
296.e: The first day of the lunar cycle: Bow in humility and meditate on the One, the Universal Creator Lord God.

296.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
296.t: gun gobi(n)dh gupaal prabh saran parau har rai ||
296.e: Praise God, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World; seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

296.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
296.t: taa kee aas kaliaan sukh jaa te sabh kachh hoi ||
296.e: Place your hopes in Him, for salvation and peace; all things come from Him.

296.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
296.t: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhis bhramio tis bin avar na koi ||
296.e: I wandered around the four corners of the world and in the ten directions, but I saw nothing except Him.

296.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
296.t: bedh puraan simirat sune bahu bidh karau beechaar ||
296.e: I listened to the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, and I pondered over them in so many ways.

296.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
296.t: patit udhaaran bhai haran sukh saagar nira(n)kaar ||
296.e: The Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Formless Lord.

296.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
296.t: dhaataa bhugataa dhenahaar tis bin avar na jai ||
296.e: The Great Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower - there is no place at all without Him.

296.g: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
296.t: jo chaaheh soiee milai naanak har gun gai ||1||
296.e: You shall obtain all that you desire, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

296.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
296.t: gobi(n)dh jas gaieeaai har neet ||
296.e: Sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, each and every day.

296.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
296.t: mil bhajeeaai saadhasa(n)g mere meet ||1|| rahaau ||
296.e: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and vibrate, meditate on Him, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

296.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
296.t: salok ||
296.e: Shalok:

296.g: ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
296.t: karau ba(n)dhanaa anik vaar saran parau har rai ||
296.e: Bow in humility to the Lord, over and over again, and enter the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

296.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥
296.t: bhram kaTeeaai naanak saadhasa(n)g dhuteeaa bhaau miTai ||2||
296.e: Doubt is eradicated, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, and the love of duality is eliminated. ||2||

296.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
296.t: pauRee ||
296.e: Pauree:

296.g: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
296.t: dhuteeaa dhuramat dhoor kar gur sevaa kar neet ||
296.e: The second day of the lunar cycle: Get rid of your evil-mindedness, and serve the Guru continually.

296.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
296.t: raam ratan man tan basai taj kaam karodh lobh meet ||
296.e: The jewel of the Lord's Name shall come to dwell in your mind and body, when you renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, O my friend.

296.g: ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
296.t: maran miTai jeevan milai binaseh sagal kales ||
296.e: Conquer death and obtain eternal life; all your troubles will depart.

296.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
296.t: aap tajahu gobi(n)dh bhajahu bhaau bhagat paraves ||
296.e: Renounce your self-conceit and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe; loving devotion to Him shall permeate your being.

297.g: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
297.t: laabh milai toTaa hirai har dharageh pativa(n)t ||
297.e: You shall earn profit and suffer no loss, and in the Court of the Lord you shall be honored.

297.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
297.t: raam naam dhan sa(n)chavai saach saeh bhagava(n)t ||
297.e: Those who gather in the riches of the Lord's Name are truly wealthy, and very blessed.

297.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
297.t: uooThat baiThat har bhajahu saadhoo sa(n)g pareet ||
297.e: So, when standing up and sitting down, vibrate upon the Lord, and cherish the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

297.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਸੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
297.t: naanak dhuramat chhuT giee paarabraham base cheet ||2||
297.e: O Nanak, evil-mindedness is eradicated, when the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

297.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
297.t: salok ||
297.e: Shalok:

297.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
297.t: teen biaapeh jagat kau tureeaa paavai koi ||
297.e: The world is in the grip of the three qualities; only a few attain the fourth state of absorption.

297.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
297.t: naanak sa(n)t niramal bhe jin man vasiaa soi ||3||
297.e: O Nanak, the Saints are pure and immaculate; the Lord abides within their minds. ||3||

297.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
297.t: pauRee ||
297.e: Pauree:

297.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖੈ ਫਲ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
297.t: tirateeaa trai gun bikhai fal kab utam kab neech ||
297.e: The third day of the lunar cycle: Those who are bound by the three qualities gather poison as their fruit; now they are good, and now they are bad.

297.g: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਉ ਘਣੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
297.t: narak surag bhramatau ghano sadhaa sa(n)ghaarai meech ||
297.e: They wander endlessly in heaven and hell, until death annihilates them.

297.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
297.t: harakh sog sahasaa sa(n)saar hau hau karat bihai ||
297.e: In pleasure and pain and worldly cynicism, they pass their lives acting in ego.

297.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
297.t: jin ke'ee tiseh na jaananee chitaveh anik upai ||
297.e: They do not know the One who created them; they think up all sorts of schemes and plans.

297.g: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਸ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾਪ ॥
297.t: aadh biaadh upaadh ras kabahu na tooTai taap ||
297.e: Their minds and bodies are distracted by pleasure and pain, and their fever never departs.

297.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
297.t: paarabraham pooran dhanee neh boojhai parataap ||
297.e: They do not realize the glorious radiance of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Lord and Master.

297.g: ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਬੂਡਤ ਘਣੋ ਮਹਾ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥
297.t: moh bharam booddat ghano mahaa narak meh vaas ||
297.e: So many are being drowned in emotional attachment and doubt; they dwell in the most horrible hell.

297.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
297.t: kar kirapaa prabh raakh leh naanak teree aas ||3||
297.e: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and save me! Nanak places his hopes in You. ||3||

297.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
297.t: salok ||
297.e: Shalok:

297.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
297.t: chatur siaanaa sughaR soi jin tajiaa abhimaan ||
297.e: One who renounces egotistical pride is intelligent, wise and refined.

297.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
297.t: chaar padhaarath asaT sidh bhaj naanak har naam ||4||
297.e: The four cardinal blessings, and the eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas are obtained, O Nanak, by meditating, vibrating on the Lord's Name. ||4||

297.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
297.t: pauRee ||
297.e: Pauree:

297.g: ਚਤੁਰਥਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੋਧਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
297.t: chaturath chaare bedh sun sodhio tat beechaar ||
297.e: The fourth day of the lunar cycle: Listening to the four Vedas, and contemplating the essence of reality, I have come to realize

297.g: ਸਰਬ ਖੇਮ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
297.t: sarab khem kaliaan nidh raam naam jap saar ||
297.e: that the treasure of all joy and comfort is found in sublime meditation on the Lord's Name.

297.g: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
297.t: narak nivaarai dhukh harai tooTeh anik kales ||
297.e: One is saved from hell, suffering is destroyed, countless pains depart,

297.g: ਮੀਚੁ ਹੁਟੈ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
297.t: meech huTai jam te chhuTai har keeratan paraves ||
297.e: death is overcome, and one escapes the Messenger of Death, by absorption in the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

297.g: ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
297.t: bhau binasai a(n)mrit rasai ra(n)g rate nira(n)kaar ||
297.e: Fear departs, and one savors the Ambrosial Nectar, imbued with the Love of the Formless Lord.

297.g: ਦੁਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
297.t: dhukh dhaaridh apavitrataa naaseh naam adhaar ||
297.e: Pain, poverty and impurity are removed, with the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

297.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
297.t: sur nar mun jan khojate sukh saagar gopaal ||
297.e: The angels, the seers and the silent sages search for the Ocean of peace, the Sustainer of the world.

297.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੪॥
297.t: man niramal mukh uoojalaa hoi naanak saadh ravaal ||4||
297.e: The mind becomes pure, and one's face is radiant, O Nanak, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

297.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
297.t: salok ||
297.e: Shalok:

297.g: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਰਾਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
297.t: pa(n)ch bikaar man meh base raache maiaa sa(n)g ||
297.e: The five evil passions dwell in the mind of one who is engrossed in Maya.

297.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੫॥
297.t: saadhasa(n)g hoi niramalaa naanak prabh kai ra(n)g ||5||
297.e: In the Saadh Sangat, one becomes pure, O Nanak, imbued with the Love of God. ||5||

297.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
297.t: pauRee ||
297.e: Pauree:

297.g: ਪੰਚਮਿ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ॥
297.t: pa(n)cham pa(n)ch pradhaan te jeh jaanio parapa(n)ch ||
297.e: The fifth day of the lunar cycle: They are the self-elect, the most distinguished, who know the true nature of the world.

297.g: ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਲਬੰਚੁ ॥
297.t: kusam baas bahu ra(n)g ghano sabh mithiaa balaba(n)ch ||
297.e: The many colors and scents of flowers - all worldly deceptions are transitory and false.

297.g: ਨਹ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
297.t: neh jaapai neh boojheeaai neh kachh karat beechaar ||
297.e: People do not see, and they do not understand; they do not reflect upon anything.

297.g: ਸੁਆਦ ਮੋਹ ਰਸ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
297.t: suaadh moh ras bedhio agiaan rachio sa(n)saar ||
297.e: The world is pierced through with attachment to tastes and pleasures, engrossed in ignorance.

297.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਣ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
297.t: janam maran bahu jon bhraman keene karam anek ||
297.e: Those who perform empty religious rituals will be born, only to die again. They wander through endless incarnations.

297.g: ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
297.t: rachanahaar neh simario man na beechaar bibek ||
297.e: They do not meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord; their minds do not understand.

297.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
297.t: bhaau bhagat bhagavaan sa(n)g maiaa lipat na ra(n)ch ||
297.e: By loving devotion to the Lord God, you shall not be polluted by Maya at all.

297.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਨ ਰਚਹਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ॥੫॥
297.t: naanak birale paie'eeh jo na racheh parapa(n)ch ||5||
297.e: O Nanak, how rare are those, who are not engrossed in worldly entanglements. ||5||

297.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
297.t: salok ||
297.e: Shalok:

297.g: ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਊਚੌ ਕਹਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
297.t: khaT saasatr uoochau kaheh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
297.e: The six Shaastras proclaim Him to be the greatest; He has no end or limitation.

297.g: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੬॥
297.t: bhagat soheh gun gaavate naanak prabh kai dhuaar ||6||
297.e: The devotees look beauteous, O Nanak, when they sing the Glories of God at His Door. ||6||

297.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
297.t: pauRee ||
297.e: Pauree:

297.g: ਖਸਟਮਿ ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
297.t: khasaTam khaT saasatr kaheh si(n)mirat katheh anek ||
297.e: The sixth day of the lunar cycle: The six Shaastras say, and countless Simritees assert,

298.g: ਊਤਮੁ ਊਚੌ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਖ ॥
298.t: uootam uoochau paarabraham gun a(n)t na jaaneh sekh ||
298.e: that the Supreme Lord God is the most sublime and lofty. Even the thousand-tongued serpent does not know the limits of His Glories.

298.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਕ ਬਿਆਸ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
298.t: naaradh mun jan suk biaas jas gaavat gobi(n)dh ||
298.e: Naarad, the humble beings, Suk and Vyaasa sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

298.g: ਰਸ ਗੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੀਧੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਚੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
298.t: ras geedhe har siau beedhe bhagat rache bhagava(n)t ||
298.e: They are imbued with the Lord's essence; united with Him; they are absorbed in devotional worship of the Lord God.

298.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਪਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
298.t: moh maan bhram binasio paiee saran dhiaal ||
298.e: Emotional attachment, pride and doubt are eliminated, when one takes to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord.

298.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
298.t: charan kamal man tan base dharasan dhekh nihaal ||
298.e: His Lotus Feet abide within my mind and body and I am enraptured, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

298.g: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
298.t: laabh milai toTaa hirai saadhasa(n)g liv lai ||
298.e: People reap their profits, and suffer no loss, when they embrace love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

298.g: ਖਾਟਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
298.t: khaaT khajaanaa gun nidh hare naanak naam dhiaai ||6||
298.e: They gather in the treasure of the Lord, the Ocean of Excellence, O Nanak, by meditating on the Naam. ||6||

298.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
298.t: salok ||
298.e: Shalok:

298.g: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਥਹਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
298.t: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal har jas katheh boleh sat subhai ||
298.e: In the gathering of the Saints, chant the Praises of the Lord, and speak the Truth with love.

298.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
298.t: naanak man sa(n)tokheeaai ekas siau liv lai ||7||
298.e: O Nanak, the mind becomes contented, enshrining love for the One Lord. ||7||

298.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
298.t: pauRee ||
298.e: Pauree:

298.g: ਸਪਤਮਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
298.t: sapatam sa(n)chahu naam dhan TooT na jaeh bha(n)ddaar ||
298.e: The seventh day of the lunar cycle: Gather the wealth of the Naam; this is a treasure which shall never be exhausted.

298.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
298.t: sa(n)tasa(n)gat meh paieeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
298.e: In the Society of the Saints, He is obtained; He has no end or limitations.

298.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
298.t: aap tajahu gobi(n)dh bhajahu saran parahu har rai ||
298.e: Renounce your selfishness and conceit, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe; take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

298.g: ਦੂਖ ਹਰੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
298.t: dhookh harai bhavajal tarai man chi(n)dhiaa fal pai ||
298.e: Your pains shall depart - swim across the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

298.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
298.t: aaTh pahar man har japai safal janam paravaan ||
298.e: One who meditates on the Lord twenty-four hours a day - fruitful and blessed is his coming into the world.

298.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
298.t: a(n)tar baahar sadhaa sa(n)g karanaihaar pachhaan ||
298.e: Inwardly and outwardly, realize that the Creator Lord is always with you.

298.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
298.t: so saajan so sakhaa meet jo har kee mat dhei ||
298.e: He is your friend, your companion, your very best friend, who imparts the Teachings of the Lord.

298.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਇ ॥੭॥
298.t: naanak tis balihaaranai har har naam japei ||7||
298.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to one who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

298.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
298.t: salok ||
298.e: Shalok:

298.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਜੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
298.t: aaTh pahar gun gaie'eeh taje'eeh avar ja(n)jaal ||
298.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord twenty-four hours a day; renounce other entanglements.

298.g: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੮॥
298.t: jamaka(n)kar joh na sakiee naanak prabhoo dhiaal ||8||
298.e: The Minister of Death cannot even see that person, O Nanak, unto whom God is merciful. ||8||

298.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
298.t: pauRee ||
298.e: Pauree:

298.g: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
298.t: asaTamee asaT sidh nav nidh ||
298.e: The eighth day of the lunar cycle: The eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the nine treasures,

298.g: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
298.t: sagal padhaarath pooran budh ||
298.e: all precious things, perfect intellect,

298.g: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
298.t: kaval pragaas sadhaa aana(n)dh ||
298.e: the opening of the heart-lotus, eternal bliss,

298.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
298.t: niramal reet nirodhar ma(n)t ||
298.e: pure lifestyle, the infallible Mantra,

298.g: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
298.t: sagal dharam pavitr isanaan ||
298.e: all Dharmic virtues, sacred purifying baths,

298.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਊਚ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
298.t: sabh meh uooch bisekh giaan ||
298.e: the most lofty and sublime spiritual wisdom

298.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
298.t: har har bhajan poore gur sa(n)g ||
298.e: these are obtained by meditating, vibrating upon the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Perfect Guru.

298.g: ਜਪਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥
298.t: jap tareeaai naanak naam har ra(n)g ||8||
298.e: You shall be saved, O Nanak, by lovingly chanting the Lord's Name. ||8||

298.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
298.t: salok ||
298.e: Shalok:

298.g: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
298.t: naarain neh simario mohio suaadh bikaar ||
298.e: He does not remember the Lord in meditation; he is fascinated by the pleasures of corruption.

298.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੯॥
298.t: naanak naam bisaariaai narak surag avataar ||9||
298.e: O Nanak, forgetting the Naam, he is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||9||

298.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
298.t: pauRee ||
298.e: Pauree:

298.g: ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਪਵੀਤ ॥
298.t: naumee nave chhidhr apaveet ||
298.e: The ninth day of the lunar cycle: The nine holes of the body are defiled.

298.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
298.t: har naam na japeh karat bipareet ||
298.e: People do not chant the Lord's Name; instead, they practice evil.

298.g: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਮਹਿ ਬਕਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਿੰਦ ॥
298.t: par tria rameh bakeh saadh ni(n)dh ||
298.e: They commit adultery, slander the Saints,

298.g: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
298.t: karan na sunahee har jas bi(n)dh ||
298.e: and do not listen to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Praise.

298.g: ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਉਦਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
298.t: hireh par dharab udhar kai taiee ||
298.e: They steal others' wealth for the sake of their own bellies,

298.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
298.t: agan na nivarai tirasanaa na bujhaiee ||
298.e: but the fire is not extinguished, and their thirst is not quenched.

298.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਹ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
298.t: har sevaa bin eh fal laage ||
298.e: Without serving the Lord, these are their rewards.

298.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੯॥
298.t: naanak prabh bisarat mar jameh abhaage ||9||
298.e: O Nanak, forgetting God, the unfortunate people are born, only to die. ||9||

298.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
298.t: salok ||
298.e: Shalok:

298.g: ਦਸ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
298.t: dhas dhis khojat mai firio jat dhekhau tat soi ||
298.e: I have wandered, searching in the ten directions - wherever I look, there I see Him.

298.g: ਮਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੦॥
298.t: man bas aavai naanakaa je pooran kirapaa hoi ||10||
298.e: The mind comes to be controlled, O Nanak, if He grants His Perfect Grace. ||10||

298.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
298.t: pauRee ||
298.e: Pauree:

298.g: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
298.t: dhasamee dhas dhuaar bas keene ||
298.e: The tenth day of the lunar cycle: Overpower the ten sensory and motor organs;

298.g: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
298.t: man sa(n)tokh naam jap leene ||
298.e: your mind will be content, as you chant the Naam.

298.g: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਜਸੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
298.t: karanee suneeaai jas gopaal ||
298.e: With your ears, hear the Praises of the Lord of the World;

298.g: ਨੈਨੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
298.t: nainee pekhat saadh dhiaal ||
298.e: with your eyes, behold the kind, Holy Saints.

298.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
298.t: rasanaa gun gaavai bea(n)t ||
298.e: With your tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

298.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
298.t: man meh chitavai pooran bhagava(n)t ||
298.e: In your mind, remember the Perfect Lord God.

299.e: With your hands and feet, work for the Saints.

299.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
299.t: naanak ih sa(n)jam prabh kirapaa paieeaai ||10||
299.e: O Nanak, this way of life is obtained by God's Grace. ||10||
Shalok:

299.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਦੁ ॥
299.t: eko ek bakhaaneeaai biralaa jaanai savaiaadh ||
299.e: Describe the Lord as the One, the One and Only. How rare are those who know the taste of this essence.

299.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧੧॥
299.t: gun gobi(n)dh na jaaneeaai naanak sabh bisamaadh ||11||
299.e: The Glories of the Lord of the Universe cannot be known. O Nanak, He is totally amazing and wonderful! ||11||
Pauree:
The eleventh day of the lunar cycle: Behold the Lord, the Lord, near at hand.

299.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
299.t: ei(n)dhree bas kar sunahu har naam ||
299.e: Subdue the desires of your sexual organs, and listen to the Lord's Name.
Let your mind be content, and be kind to all beings.
In this way, your fast will be successful.
Keep your wandering mind restrained in one place.

299.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
299.t: man tan sudh japat har nai ||
299.e: Your mind and body shall become pure, chanting the Lord's Name.
The Supreme Lord God is pervading amongst all.

299.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਟਲ ਏਹੁ ਧਰਮ ॥੧੧॥
299.t: naanak har keeratan kar aTal eh dharam ||11||
299.e: O Nanak, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this alone is the eternal faith of Dharma. ||11||
Shalok:

299.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
299.t: dhuramat haree sevaa karee bheTe saadh kirapaal ||
299.e: Evil-mindedness is eliminated, by meeting with and serving the compassionate Holy Saints.

299.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧੨॥
299.t: naanak prabh siau mil rahe binase sagal ja(n)jaal ||12||
299.e: Nanak is merged with God; all his entanglements have come to an end. ||12||
Pauree:
The twelfth day of the lunar cycle: Dedicate yourself to giving charity, chanting the Naam and purification.

299.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
299.t: har kee bhagat karahu taj maan ||
299.e: Worship the Lord with devotion, and get rid of your pride.
Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The mind is satisfied by lovingly singing the Kirtan of God's Praises.
The Sweet Words of His Bani soothe everyone.

299.g: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਪੋਖੈ ॥
299.t: pa(n)ch bhoo aatamaa har naam ras pokhai ||
299.e: The soul, the subtle essence of the five elements, cherishes the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

299.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਏਹ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
299.t: gur poore te eh nihachau paieeaai ||
299.e: This faith is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

299.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧੨॥
299.t: naanak raam ramat fir jon na aaieeaai ||12||
299.e: O Nanak, dwelling upon the Lord, you shall not enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||12||
Shalok:

299.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
299.t: teen gunaa meh biaapiaa pooran hot na kaam ||
299.e: Engrossed in the three qualities, one's efforts do not succeed.

299.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮ ॥੧੩॥
299.t: patit udhaaran man basai naanak chhooTai naam ||13||
299.e: When the Saving Grace of sinners dwells in the mind, O Nanak, then one is saved by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||
Pauree:
The thirteenth day of the lunar cycle: The world is in the fever of the three qualities.
It comes and goes, and is reincarnated in hell.

299.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
299.t: har har bhajan na man meh aaio ||
299.e: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, does not enter into the minds of the people.

299.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
299.t: sukh saagar prabh nimakh na gaio ||
299.e: They do not sing the Praises of God, the Ocean of peace, even for an instant.

299.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥
299.t: harakh sog kaa dheh kar baadhio ||
299.e: This body is the embodiment of pleasure and pain.
It suffers from the chronic and incurable disease of Maya.
By day, people practice corruption, wearing themselves out.
And then with sleep in their eyes, they mutter in dreams.
Forgetting the Lord, this is their condition.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the kind and compassionate Primal Being. ||13||
Shalok:

299.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
299.t: chaar ku(n)T chaudheh bhavan sagal biaapat raam ||
299.e: The Lord is pervading in all the four directions and the fourteen worlds.

299.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧੪॥
299.t: naanak uoon na dhekheeaai pooran taa ke kaam ||14||
299.e: O Nanak, He is not seen to be lacking anything; His works are perfectly complete. ||14||
Pauree:
The fourteenth day of the lunar cycle: God Himself is in all four directions.
On all worlds, His radiant glory is perfect.
The One God is diffused in the ten directions.

299.g: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
299.t: dharan akaas sabh meh prabh pekh ||
299.e: Behold God in all the earth and sky.
In the water, on the land, in the forests and mountains, and in the nether regions of the underworld,
the Merciful Transcendent Lord is abiding.
The Lord God is in all mind and matter, subtle and manifest.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes God. ||14||
Shalok:

299.g: ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
299.t: aatam jeetaa gurmatee gun gaae gobi(n)dh ||
299.e: The soul is conquered, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glories of God.

299.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧੫॥
299.t: sa(n)t prasaadhee bhai miTe naanak binasee chi(n)dh ||15||
299.e: By the Grace of the Saints, fear is dispelled, O Nanak, and anxiety is ended. ||15||
Pauree:

299.g: ਅਮਾਵਸ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
299.t: amaavas aatam sukhee bhe sa(n)tokh dheeaa gurdhev ||
299.e: The day of the new moon: My soul is at peace; the Divine Guru has blessed me with contentment.

300.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
300.t: man tan seetal saa(n)t sahaj laagaa prabh kee sev ||
300.e: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, in intuitive peace and poise; I have dedicated myself to serving God.

300.g: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਫਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
300.t: TooTe ba(n)dhan bahu bikaar safal pooran taa ke kaam || dhuramat miTee haumai chhuTee simarat har ko naam ||
300.e: One who meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord - his bonds are broken, all his sins are erased, and his works are brought to perfect fruition; his evil-mindedness disappears, and his ego is subdued.

300.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ॥
300.t: saran gahee paarabraham kee miTiaa aavaa gavan ||
300.e: Taking to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, his comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.

300.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਵਨ ॥
300.t: aap tariaa kuTa(n)b siau gun gubi(n)dh prabh ravan ||
300.e: He saves himself, along with his family, chanting the Praises of God, the Lord of the Universe.

300.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
300.t: har kee Tahal kamaavanee japeeaai prabh kaa naam ||
300.e: I serve the Lord, and I chant the Name of God.

300.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੫॥
300.t: gur poore te paiaa naanak sukh bisraam ||15||
300.e: From the Perfect Guru, Nanak has obtained peace and comfortable ease. ||15||

300.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
300.t: salok ||
300.e: Shalok:

300.g: ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ॥
300.t: pooran kabahu na ddolataa pooraa keeaa prabh aap ||
300.e: The perfect person never wavers; God Himself made him perfect.

300.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧੬॥
300.t: dhin dhin chaRai savaiaa naanak hot na ghaaT ||16||
300.e: Day by day, he prospers; O Nanak, he shall not fail. ||16||

300.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
300.t: pauRee ||
300.e: Pauree:

300.g: ਪੂਰਨਮਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
300.t: pooranamaa pooran prabh ek karan kaaran samarath ||
300.e: The day of the full moon: God alone is Perfect; He is the All-powerful Cause of causes.

300.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਥੁ ॥
300.t: jeea ja(n)t dhiaal purakh sabh uoopar jaa kaa hath ||
300.e: The Lord is kind and compassionate to all beings and creatures; His Protecting Hand is over all.

300.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
300.t: gun nidhaan gobi(n)dh gur keeaa jaa kaa hoi ||
300.e: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Lord of the Universe; through the Guru, He acts.

300.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
300.t: a(n)tarajaamee prabh sujaan alakh nira(n)jan soi ||
300.e: God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is All-knowing, Unseen and Immaculately Pure.

300.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰ ॥
300.t: paarabraham paramesaro sabh bidh jaananahaar ||
300.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is the Knower of all ways and means.

300.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
300.t: sa(n)t sahaiee saran jog aaTh pahar namasakaar ||
300.e: He is the Support of His Saints, with the Power to give Sanctuary. Twenty-four hours a day, I bow in reverence to Him.

300.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥
300.t: akath kathaa neh boojheeaai simarahu har ke charan ||
300.e: His Unspoken Speech cannot be understood; I meditate on the Feet of the Lord.

300.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥੧੬॥
300.t: patit udhaaran anaath naath naanak prabh kee saran ||16||
300.e: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Master of the masterless; Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary. ||16||

300.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
300.t: salok ||
300.e: Shalok:

300.g: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
300.t: dhukh binase sahasaa gio saran gahee har rai ||
300.e: My pain is gone, and my sorrows have departed, since I took to the Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

300.g: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
300.t: man chi(n)dhe fal paiaa naanak har gun gai ||17||
300.e: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||17||

300.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
300.t: pauRee ||
300.e: Pauree:

300.g: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
300.t: koiee gaavai ko sunai koiee karai beechaar ||
300.e: Some sing, some listen, and some contemplate;

300.g: ਕੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
300.t: ko upadhesai ko dhiraRai tis kaa hoi udhaar ||
300.e: some preach, and some implant the Name within; this is how they are saved.

300.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
300.t: kilabikh kaaTai hoi niramalaa janam janam mal jai ||
300.e: Their sinful mistakes are erased, and they become pure; the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

300.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
300.t: halat palat mukh uoojalaa neh pohai tis mai ||
300.e: In this world and the next, their faces shall be radiant; they shall not be touched by Maya.

300.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
300.t: so surataa so baisano so giaanee dhanava(n)t ||
300.e: They are intuitively wise, and they are Vaishnaavs, worshippers of Vishnu; they are spiritually wise, wealthy and prosperous.

300.g: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
300.t: so sooraa kulava(n)t soi jin bhajiaa bhagava(n)t ||
300.e: They are spiritual heros, of noble birth, who vibrate upon the Lord God.

300.g: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਬੈਸੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
300.t: khatree braahaman soodh bais udharai simar cha(n)ddaal ||
300.e: The Kh'shatriyas, the Brahmins, the low-caste Soodras, the Vaisha workers and the outcast pariahs are all saved,

300.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧੭॥
300.t: jin jaanio prabh aapanaa naanak tiseh ravaal ||17||
300.e: meditating on the Lord. Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who know his God. ||17||

300.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
300.t: gauRee kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
300.e: Vaar In Gauree, Fourth Mehla:

300.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
300.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
300.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

300.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
300.t: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
300.e: Shalok Fourth Mehla:

300.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
300.t: satigur purakh dhiaal hai jis no samat sabh koi ||
300.e: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is kind and compassionate; all are alike to Him.

300.g: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਮਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
300.t: ek dhirasaT kar dhekhadhaa man bhaavanee te sidh hoi ||
300.e: He looks upon all impartially; with pure faith in the mind, He is obtained.

300.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
300.t: satigur vich a(n)mrit hai har utam har padh soi ||
300.e: The Ambrosial Nectar is within the True Guru; He is exalted and sublime, of Godly status.

300.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
300.t: naanak kirapaa te har dhiaaieeaai gurmukh paavai koi ||1||
300.e: O Nanak, by His Grace, one meditates on the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain Him. ||1||

300.t: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
300.e: Fourth Mehla:

300.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
300.t: haumai maiaa sabh bikh hai nit jag toTaa sa(n)saar ||
300.e: Egotism and Maya are total poison; in these, people continually suffer loss in this world.

300.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
300.t: laahaa har dhan khaTiaa gurmukh sabadh veechaar ||
300.e: The Gurmukh earns the profit of the wealth of the Lord's Name, contemplating the Word of the Shabad.

300.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
300.t: haumai mail bikh utarai har a(n)mrit har ur dhaar ||
300.e: The poisonous filth of egotism is removed, when one enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within the heart.
